96	## 4. End-to-end flow (the one-paragraph answer)
97	
98	Sunil runs `install_memo.bat` once (checks Node/Git, writes `~/.memo/config.json`, merges MEMO hooks into `~/.claude/settings.json`, asks for API key → user env var, registers the 15-min task) and `memo init` once per repo. He opens Claude Code in the repo. **`SessionStart`** hook → `memo capture` registers the session and prints `PROJECT_STATE` summary into Claude's context. After every assistant turn **`Stop`** (async) → `memo capture` reads the new transcript bytes, normalizes + redacts them, appends to `.memory/sessions/2026/10/22/<sid>.jsonl`. Every 15 min the **worker** (`memo cycle`) takes a lock, sweeps all known sessions for missed bytes, sends only *new* events (+ the list of open records) to the API, validates the JSON, appends records to `.memory/records/*.jsonl`, writes the session summary, re-renders `PROJECT_STATE.md` and `TASKS.md`, and commits **only `.memory/`**. If the API fails, events stay on disk, the job stays pending, the next cycle retries. If the hook fails, Claude Code continues (async, exit 0). Next day, a new Claude Code session gets the state injected automatically; any other agent reads `AGENTS.md` → `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md`.
99	
100	```
101	Claude Code ──hooks(stdin JSON)──► memo capture ──► .memory/sessions/…/<sid>.jsonl   (local, seconds)
102	                                         ▲
103	Task Scheduler (15 min) ──► memo cycle ──┼─► sweep capture
104	                                         ├─► LLM API (new events only) ──► validate ──► .memory/records/*.jsonl
105	                                         ├─► render PROJECT_STATE.md, TASKS.md, session summary .md
106	                                         └─► git commit --only -- .memory        (no push)
107	New session ──SessionStart──► memo capture --context ──stdout──► Claude context
108	```

177	state/<repoId>/jobs.json      {jobId: {sid, from, to, status, attempts, lastError, ts}}
178	logs/cycles.jsonl  logs/capture.jsonl  logs/usage.jsonl  hook-errors.log
179	cycle.lock  state/<repoId>/capture.lock

184	
185	## 6. Data contracts
186	
187	### 6.1 Event envelope (one line in `<sid>.jsonl`)
188	```json
189	{"v":1,"id":"e-3f2a9c1d","sid":"8c1e…","seq":42,"ts":"2026-10-22T14:03:11.120+05:30",
190	 "agent":"claude-code","type":"tool_result","tool":"Bash",
191	 "text":"npm test … # pass 15 # fail 0","ok":true,"truncated":true,"src":{"line":118,"uuid":"…"}}
192	```
193	- `type` ∈ `user_prompt | assistant_text | tool_call | tool_result | system | git_commit`
194	- `id` = `e-` + first 8 hex of `sha1(sid + (uuid || line text) + blockIndex)`. Dedup key.
195	- `seq` = monotonic per session (assigned at append time).
196	- `text` limits: user_prompt 4,000 chars; assistant_text 3,000; tool_call 300 (Bash command / file path only); tool_result 800 (first 500 + last 300). `truncated:true` if cut.
197	- `ok` for tool_result: `false` if transcript marks error, else `true`; unknown → omit.
198	- **Dropped entirely:** thinking blocks, `Read` results (keep only `tool_call` with path), `Write`/`Edit` content (keep path + line counts), anything touching denylisted paths (§6.5), image blocks.
199	- File paths stored **relative to repo root**; paths outside repo → `"<outside-repo>"`.
200	
201	### 6.2 Record line (`records/<type>.jsonl`, append-only op-log)
202	```json
203	{"op":"create","id":"D-7a1c09e2","type":"decision","ts":"2026-10-22T14:15:00+05:30","job":"j-5d0e…",
204	 "statement":"Keep .memory/ as canonical folder","rationale":"avoids migration","status":"active",
205	 "confidence":"high","evidence":["e-3f2a9c1d","e-91bc0a11"],"sessions":["8c1e…"],"files":["src/init.js"]}
206	```
207	- `op` ∈ `create | update | delete` (delete only from `memo clear`).
208	- Types and allowed `status`:
209	
210	| type | statuses |
211	|---|---|
212	| decision | `proposed, active, superseded, rejected` |
213	| error | `observed, investigating, attempted, resolved_unverified, verified, reopened` |
214	| learning / fact | `active, unverified, superseded` |
215	| task | `open, in_progress, blocked, implemented_unverified, verified, done, cancelled, superseded` |
216	| question | `open, answered` |
217	| intent | `active, historical` |
218	
219	- Task-only fields: `title, priority (high|normal|low|unranked), effort_estimate ("30-60m"), effort_basis:"estimated", capability (low|medium|high), capability_reason, blockers[], completion_evidence[], auto_exec:false`.
220	- Optional: `supersedes`, `related[]`, `conflict_with[]`, `downgraded:true` (code changed the model's status), `source:"legacy"|"manual"|"llm"`.
221	- Current state = fold lines by `id` in file order; `delete` removes.
222	- ID = type prefix (`D E L F T Q I`) + `-` + 8 hex of `sha1(type + normalized statement + first evidence id)`.
223	
224	### 6.3 LLM extraction contract
225	**Request** (built by `extract/prompt.js`):
226	- `system`: rules (≤ 1,500 tokens, fixed text, cache-friendly): extract only what evidence supports; never mark verified without a passing tool result; rejected options are `rejected`, not decisions; no invented deadlines/owners; reuse existing ids for the same issue; output JSON only.
227	- `user`: `{"repo":"<folder name>","open_records":[{id,type,status,statement}] (≤ 60, newest first), "events":[envelopes…]}`.
228	- Input cap: `config.maxInputTokensPerCall` (default 12,000; estimate tokens = chars/4). Larger batches split by `seq`, in order.
229	
230	**Response** (validated by `extract/validate.js`):
231	```json
232	{"schema":1,
233	 "session_summary":"≤ 600 chars, what happened in these events",
234	 "items":[
235	   {"op":"create","type":"error","statement":"…","status":"observed","confidence":"medium","evidence":["e-…"],"files":["src/x.js"]},
236	   {"op":"update","id":"T-1b2c3d4e","status":"implemented_unverified","evidence":["e-…"]},
237	   {"op":"create","type":"task","title":"…","statement":"…","priority":"normal","effort_estimate":"1-2h","capability":"medium","capability_reason":"touches 3 modules","evidence":["e-…"]}
238	 ],
239	 "gaps":["tool output truncated for e-…"]}
240	```
241	**Validator rules (code, not model):**
242	1. JSON parse; on failure → 1 repair retry with the parse error; then job `failed_permanent`.
243	2. Unknown fields dropped; enums enforced; strings ≤ 500 chars; ≤ 25 items.
244	3. Every `evidence` id must exist in this batch or be an existing record id; otherwise item dropped and logged.
245	4. `update.id` must exist and `type` must match.
246	5. `verified`/`done` require ≥1 evidence event of type `tool_result` with `ok:true` → else downgraded to `resolved_unverified` / `implemented_unverified`, `downgraded:true`.
247	6. `intent` create/update requires evidence of type `user_prompt`.
248	7. `files` must be relative, no `..`, no drive letter, no leading `/`; else dropped.
249	8. Model output is never executed, never used as a path outside `.memory/`, never changes config.
250	
251	### 6.4 `~/.memo/config.json` (defaults)
252	```json
253	{"v":1,"provider":"anthropic","model":"<set in P0>","consolidationModel":null,
254	 "apiKeyEnv":"MEMO_API_KEY","apiEnabled":true,"paused":false,
255	 "intervalMinutes":15,"maxInputTokensPerCall":12000,"maxCallsPerCycle":6,
256	 "monthlyBudgetUsd":5,"summaryLanguage":"en",
257	 "prices":{"<model>":{"inPerM":0.10,"outPerM":0.50}},
258	 "denyPaths":[".env",".env.*","*.pem","*.key","id_rsa*","credentials*.json","secrets/**"],
259	 "autoCommit":true,"commitIdentity":null}
260	```
261	API key: read from env var named by `apiKeyEnv` (fallback `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY`). Never printed; `memo doctor` shows only `set (sk-…last4)`.
262	
263	### 6.5 Redaction (extend `src/redact.js`)
264	Keep existing patterns. Add: `sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}`, `sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}`, connection strings `\b\w+://[^\s:@/]+:[^\s@/]+@` (keep scheme, redact credentials), `.env`-style lines `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}=\S{8,}$` (multiline), high-entropy 40+ char base64/hex tokens next to words key/secret/token. Add `redactPath(relPath, denyPaths) → boolean drop`. Order: redact at capture (disk) **and** again in `prompt.js` (defence in depth).
265	
266	---
267	
268	## 7. Global engineering rules (all phases)
269	
270	- Node ≥ 20. `package.json` `"test": "node --test"` (auto-discovers `test/**/*.test.js` on all OSes).
271	- Every write of a whole file: write `file.tmp` → `fs.renameSync` (atomic). JSONL: one complete line per `appendFileSync`.
272	- Every `git` call: `execFileSync('git', args, {cwd, encoding:'utf8', windowsHide:true})`. Never through a shell string.
273	- Every spawned process: `windowsHide: true`.
274	- Times: store ISO 8601 with offset; display local `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.
275	- Paths: `path.join` everywhere; when writing into hook files/settings, use forward slashes.
276	- Hooks and worker: catch everything, log to `~/.memo/logs`, exit 0.
277	- No timestamps change in tracked files unless content changed (prevents empty-diff commits).
278	- `MEMO_HOME` env overrides `~/.memo` (tests). `MEMO_CLAUDE_SETTINGS` overrides `~/.claude/settings.json` path (tests).
279

370	## P1 — Claude Code capture  · Deadline Thu 22 Oct
371	
372	### Goal / user-visible result
373	After `memo setup claude` (once per machine) and `memo init` (once per repo), every Claude Code session in that repo is written to `.memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl` within seconds of each turn, redacted, without any manual step. No API yet.
374	
375	### Send to builder
376	This plan §0, §5, §6.1, §6.5, §7, P1; files `bin/memo.js`, `src/paths.js`, `src/git.js`, `src/redact.js`, `src/init.js`, `package.json`; `docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md`; the 3 fixtures.
377	
378	### Files
379	New: `src/repos.js`, `src/lock.js`, `src/log.js`, `src/capture/claude.js`, `src/capture/capture.js`, `src/capture/install-claude.js`, `src/store/sessions.js`, tests `test/capture-normalize.test.js`, `test/capture-incremental.test.js`, `test/install-claude.test.js`, `test/redact.test.js` (extend).
380	Changed: `bin/memo.js`, `src/paths.js`, `src/redact.js`, `src/init.js` (register repo in `repos.json`, create `.memory/sessions/`).
381	
382	### Spec
383	**Commands**
384	- `memo setup claude [--dry-run]`: back up `~/.claude/settings.json` → `settings.json.memo-backup-<ts>`; merge MEMO hook entries for `SessionStart` (sync, timeout 10), `Stop` (async), `PreCompact` (async), `SessionEnd` (sync, timeout 5). Command = absolute `process.execPath`, args = [absolute `bin/memo.js`, `capture`] (forward slashes). Mark entries so they're recognisable (e.g. args contains `memo.js` + `capture`). Idempotent: second run reports `skipped`. Never removes other hooks. Invalid existing JSON → abort with message, change nothing.
385	- `memo setup claude --remove`: removes only MEMO entries.
386	- `memo capture`: hook entry. Reads stdin JSON (max 1 MB, 2 s timeout). Fields used: `session_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `hook_event_name`, `source` (SessionStart), `reason` if present (SessionEnd).
387	- `memo capture --sweep`: for every registered repo and every cursor, catch up (used by worker in P4).
388	
389	**`memo capture` algorithm**
390	1. Resolve repo root from `cwd` via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`. Not registered or `enabled:false` → log `skip unregistered`, exit 0.
391	2. Acquire `~/.memo/state/<repoId>/capture.lock` (create exclusive; stale if older than 60 s → take over, log it). Busy → exit 0 (sweep will catch up).
392	3. Load cursor for `sid`. New session → create cursor `{offset:0}`, add to `index.json` with `date` = local date of first event ts, `agent:"claude-code"`, `start`.
393	4. `stat` transcript. Missing → log `transcript_missing`, mark gap in index, exit 0. `size < offset` → transcript rewritten → set `offset:0`, rely on event-id dedup, log `transcript_rewritten`.
394	5. Read bytes `[offset, size)`. Prepend stored `partial`. Split on `\n`; the last piece without `\n` becomes the new `partial`.
395	6. Each complete line → `JSON.parse` (bad line → log `bad_line` with line number, skip) → `normalize(line, ctx)` from `capture/claude.js` → 0..n envelopes.
396	7. Drop envelopes whose `id` already exists in the session file (keep a Set loaded from the last 2,000 ids of the file).
397	8. Redact `text`. Drop denylisted paths. Append lines. `fsync`. Then save cursor (atomic). Update `index.json` (`events`, `end` = last ts, `status`).
398	9. `SessionEnd` → mark session `ended` in index. `SessionStart` with `source:"resume"` → same sid continues same file.
399	10. Total budget: must finish < 1 s for 1 MB of new transcript.
400	
401	**`capture/claude.js` normalize** — mapping defined by the P0 fixtures. Expected shape (verify against fixtures, fixtures win): line `type:"user"` with string content → `user_prompt`; user content array item `tool_result` → `tool_result` (`ok:false` if `is_error`); line `type:"assistant"` content items: `text` → `assistant_text`, `tool_use` → `tool_call` (tool name + summary per §6.1), `thinking` → dropped; other line types → dropped unless they carry a summary/compaction marker → `system` ("context compacted").
402	
403	### Tests
404	- Normalize each fixture → expected envelope types/counts (snapshot as small JSON in test).
405	- Thinking blocks, Read contents, Write content never appear in output.
406	- Incremental: capture half file, then rest → no duplicate ids, `seq` continuous.
407	- Partial last line handled.
408	- Rewritten (shorter) file → no duplicates.
409	- Unregistered repo → nothing written.
410	- Secrets in prompt/tool output → `[REDACTED]` on disk.
411	- `install-claude`: empty settings, settings with other hooks, run twice, `--remove`, invalid JSON.
412	- Path with spaces and non-ASCII (`C:/Users/sunil/My Projects/मेमो`) in temp dirs.
413	
414	### Sunil checks
415	1. `memo setup claude` → `~/.claude/settings.json` mein MEMO hooks, purane hooks safe; backup file bana.
416	2. Test repo mein `memo init`, Claude Code kholo, 3–4 baat karo, ek command chalwao.
417	3. `.memory/sessions/2026/10/22/` mein `<sid>.jsonl` — har turn ke baad lines badhti hain.
418	4. File kholo: thinking nahi, file contents nahi, secret `[REDACTED]`.
419	5. Same session `claude --resume` → same file mein append, naya file nahi. Naya session → naya file.
420	6. Ek aur repo jo `memo init` nahi hua → wahan kuch nahi likha gaya.
421	
422	### Acceptance
423	Real session captured from terminal (and VS Code if P0 confirmed) with zero manual steps; replay/resume creates no duplicates; Claude Code never shows a hook error.
424	
425	### Risks / unsupported
426	Transcript format change on Claude Code update → `bad_line`/unknown-type counts visible in `memo status` (P4). Sessions started outside registered repos are ignored by design. Subagent transcripts: not captured in MVP.
427	
428	### Rollback
429	`memo setup claude --remove`; revert commit.

454	- `anthropic.js`: `POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`, headers `x-api-key`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, `content-type: application/json`; body `{model, max_tokens, system, messages:[{role:'user', content:user}]}`; use the provider's structured-output/JSON mode **only if** P0 verified it in current docs; else plain text + validator.
455	- `openai.js`: `POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions` with `response_format:{type:'json_object'}` (or Responses API if current docs require — builder must check current docs and state which it used).
456	- Both: `fetch` + `AbortController` 60 s; retries on network/429/5xx: 3 attempts, backoff 2 s / 8 s / 30 s, honour `retry-after`; 401/403 → `auth` (no retry); 400 → `bad_request`; insufficient-credit/quota errors → `quota`. Never log headers or bodies; log status, requestId, attempt.
457	- `mock.js`: returns responses from `test/fixtures/llm/` by key; can simulate 429, timeout, malformed JSON.
458	
459	**Process algorithm** (per repo, per session with `events > processedThrough`)
460	1. Budget: sum `usage.jsonl` cost for current month ≥ `monthlyBudgetUsd` → stop, status `budget_reached`.
461	2. `apiEnabled:false` or `paused` → stop, status `api_disabled`.
462	3. Batch = events `(processedThrough, …]` until token estimate hits cap. Job id = `j-` + sha1(`sid:from:to`) 10 hex.
463	4. If any record line already has this `job` → job already applied → just advance `processedThrough` (crash recovery).
464	5. Build prompt (§6.3) with open records (folded state, status not in terminal states, newest 60).
465	6. Call provider. Log usage line `{ts, repoId, job, model, in, out, costEst}` (cost from `config.prices`; unknown → `null`).
466	7. Validate (§6.3 rules). Invalid JSON → 1 repair call (`"Your previous output was not valid JSON: <error>. Return only the JSON."`) → still invalid → job `failed_permanent`, stop this session.
467	8. Assign ids to creates (§6.2). Same id already exists → convert to `update`.
468	9. Append records (each line has `job`). Write session summary `.md` (append the new summary paragraph under a timestamp; header = sid, date, agent, model, events). Advance `processedThrough` in `index.json` atomically **last**.
469	10. Retryable error → job `pending` with attempts++; next cycle retries; after 5 attempts → `failed_retryable` (still retried by `--retry-failed`).
470	11. Max `maxCallsPerCycle` calls per run across all repos; leftover backlog reported.
471	
472	### Tests (mock only)
473	- Decision fixture → 1 `decision` with rationale + evidence.
474	- Error-then-fix with passing test → `error` + update to `verified` allowed.
475	- Same but model claims verified without passing test → stored as `resolved_unverified`, `downgraded:true`.
476	- Rejected option → `decision` with `status:rejected` (not active).
477	- Unknown evidence id → item dropped.
478	- Update with nonexistent id → dropped.
479	- Malformed JSON → repair → success; double malformed → `failed_permanent`, events untouched.
480	- 429 then success → one set of records (no duplicates); 401 → `auth`, no retry.
481	- Crash simulation: records written, `processedThrough` not advanced → rerun applies nothing new.
482	- Budget reached → no call.
483	- `--dry-run` makes zero provider calls.
484	- Prompt never contains a string matching redact patterns (feed secret-bearing events).
485	
486	### Sunil checks
487	1. `memo process --dry-run` → events, tokens, ₹/$ estimate dikhe.
488	2. Real run (key set): `.memory/records/*.jsonl` mein entries; har entry mein `evidence` ids jo session file mein milte hain.
489	3. Session `.md` summary padho — sahi hai? Galat "verified" toh nahi?
490	4. Wapas `memo process` → "no new events", koi naya record nahi, koi API call nahi (`usage.jsonl` same).
491	5. Internet band karke `memo process` → error logged, kuch delete nahi hua; internet on → next run process karta hai.
492	
493	### Acceptance
494	Rev 2 §43.3 bullets pass on fixtures + one real session; normal test suite needs no key.
495	
496	### Risks
497	Model quality (false decisions) → validator + downgrade + you review first real outputs; switch model via config. API shape changed since this plan → builder must cite the current doc page it used.
498	
499	### Rollback
500	`memo config set apiEnabled false`; records are plain files — delete `.memory/records/` to reset.

583	## P4 — 15-minute worker, Windows installer, status  · Deadline Tue 27 Oct
584	
585	### Goal / user-visible result
586	Run `install_memo.bat` once → MEMO runs hidden every 15 min and after logon, processes new data, commits memory, and `memo status` shows what happened.
587	
588	### Send to builder
589	§0, §5, §7, P4; `docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md` (schtasks + hidden-window results); files `bin/memo.js`, `src/capture/capture.js`, `src/extract/process.js`, `src/report/*`, `src/gitops/memory-commit.js`, `src/config.js`, `src/lock.js`, `src/log.js`, `src/repos.js`.
590	
591	### Files
592	New: `src/cycle.js`, `src/status.js`, `scripts/windows/install_memo.bat`, `scripts/windows/uninstall_memo.bat`, `scripts/windows/memo_status.bat`, `scripts/windows/memo_console.bat`, `scripts/windows/register-task.ps1`, `scripts/windows/run-hidden.vbs` (only if P0 chose it), tests `test/cycle.test.js`, `test/lock.test.js`, `test/status.test.js`.
593	Changed: `bin/memo.js`, `src/lock.js`.
594	
595	### Spec
596	**`memo cycle`** (what the task runs):
597	1. Lock `~/.memo/cycle.lock` `{pid, startedAt}`. Exists and pid alive and < 20 min old → log `overlap_skip`, exit 0. Else stale → take over, log `stale_lock_recovered`.
598	2. Log `cycle_start`. `paused` → log `paused`, exit.
599	3. For each enabled repo: `capture --sweep` → `process` (respect budget/max calls) → render reports → `commit`. Per-repo try/catch: one repo failing doesn't stop others.
600	4. Log one line per repo: `{ts, repo, newEvents, jobs, calls, in, out, costEst, committed:sha|null, status, ms}` where status ∈ `ok | no_new_data | api_failed | budget_reached | git_busy | no_identity | capture_gap | error`.
601	5. Write `~/.memo/status.json` `{lastCycle, lastOk, lastFailed, nextExpected}`. Release lock. Exit 0 always.
602	6. Must exit in < 2 s when no new data. No API call when no new data.
603	
604	**`memo status`** (≤ 20 lines):
605	```
606	MEMO  Running (task registered, next ≈ 14:45)   API: anthropic/<model> key set   Paused: no
607	Last cycle 14:30 ok · last failure 2026-10-26 22:15 api_failed (timeout)
608	This month: 41 calls · 0.31M in / 0.05M out · ≈ $0.06 of $5 budget
609	Repos:
610	  whisper_flow_hackathon  sessions 7 · unprocessed 0 · last commit 14:30 · state fresh
611	Logs: C:/Users/<you>/.memo/logs/cycles.jsonl
612	```
613	**`memo doctor`**: check Node ≥20, git in PATH, git identity per repo, `~/.claude/settings.json` has MEMO hooks, API key env set (masked), one cheap API ping only with `--live`, scheduled task exists (`schtasks /query /tn "MEMO Background Processor"`), last cycle age < 30 min, writable dirs. Each line `PASS/FAIL + fix hint`.
614	**`memo pause` / `memo resume`**: flip `config.paused` (task stays registered).
615	
616	**`install_memo.bat`** (CRLF, idempotent, no admin unless P0 proved needed):
617	1. Check `git --version`, `node -v` ≥ 20 → else print winget command, exit.
618	2. `node "%~dp0..\..\bin\memo.js" install` → creates `~/.memo`, default config, runs `setup claude`, prints privacy notice (what is captured, what is sent, where it goes, how to disable), asks provider + model (default from findings).
619	3. API key: if `MEMO_API_KEY` not set → `set /p` prompt → `setx MEMO_API_KEY "<value>"` (warn: visible in user env; DPAPI later). Never echo the key.
620	4. Register task via `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File register-task.ps1`: action = hidden launcher → `"<node.exe>" "<memo.js>" cycle`; trigger every 15 min indefinitely; `StartWhenAvailable`; `MultipleInstances IgnoreNew`; `ExecutionTimeLimit 10 min`; plus logon (AtLogOn trigger if allowed, else shortcut in `shell:startup` running one cycle). Re-run → updates, never duplicates.
621	5. Optional: `npm link` so `memo` works in any terminal.
622	6. Self-test: `memo doctor`, then `memo cycle` once, show `memo status`.
623	7. Print what was created/updated/skipped.
624	
625	**`uninstall_memo.bat`**: remove task + startup shortcut, `memo setup claude --remove`; **does not** delete `~/.memo` or any `.memory/` unless user types `DELETE-ALL-MEMO-DATA`.
626	
627	### Tests
628	- Lock: live lock → skip; stale (dead pid or > 20 min) → recovered.
629	- No-data cycle → zero provider calls, no commit, `no_new_data` logged.
630	- Two repos, one throws → other still committed.
631	- Paused → nothing runs.
632	- Budget reached → capture + commit still run (raw events committed), no API.
633	- Status renders from fixture logs.
634	- `.bat` files have CRLF (test reads bytes).
635	
636	### Sunil checks
637	1. `install_memo.bat` double-click / PowerShell se. Dobara chalao → duplicate task nahi.
638	2. Task Scheduler mein "MEMO Background Processor" dikhe; 15 min baad `memo status` mein naya cycle. Koi black window flash nahi.
639	3. Laptop restart → login → 1–2 min mein cycle chala (status).
640	4. Claude Code mein 20 min kaam karo, haath mat lagao → `git log` mein `memo: …` commit, sirf `.memory/`.
641	5. `memo pause` → next cycle `paused`. `memo resume`.
642	6. Task Manager se cycle ke time RAM dekho (target < 100 MB).
643	
644	### Acceptance
645	Rev 2 §43.1 and scheduled part of §43.5 pass on your laptop.
646	
647	### Risks
648	AtLogOn requires admin → Startup-folder fallback. Hidden-window method may flash → choose per P0. `setx` key in plain user env → documented, DPAPI in P11. Laptop sleep → cycles resume after wake (`StartWhenAvailable`); no processing while off — expected.
649	
650	### Rollback
651	`uninstall_memo.bat`; data untouched.

732	## 10. API cost
733	
734	### 10.1 Prices used (verified 20 Oct 2026, USD per 1M tokens, standard tier)
735	| Model | Input | Output | Notes |
736	|---|---|---|---|
737	| Claude Haiku 5.5 | $0.10 | $0.50 | prompts ≤100K tokens |
738	| Claude Sonnet 5.5 | $2 | $10 | |
739	| Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 | $20 | |
740	| OpenAI gpt-6-luna | $0.10 | $0.50 | |
741	| OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol | $2 | $10 | |
742	| OpenAI gpt-6-astra | $10 | $50 | |
743	| OpenAI gpt-5.3-codex | $1.75 | $14 | coding model |
744	Batch API (both providers): ~50% off but results can take hours → only for the nightly P7 call, not the 15-min cycle. Prompt caching barely helps: Anthropic's default cache lives 5 min, our calls are 15 min apart.
745	
746	### 10.2 Runtime cost — one repo, 3 h of Claude Code per day, 30 days
747	**Assumptions (estimates, to be replaced by P6 measurements):**
748	- After filtering (§6.1: no thinking, no file contents, tool output ≤ 800 chars) ≈ **17k tokens of new events per hour** (≈15 prompts, 15 replies, 60 tool calls/results).
749	- 3 h → 12 cycles with data/day. Per call: ~1.5k system + ~3k open records + ~4.2k events ≈ **9–10k input**, ~1.5k output.
750	- Per day ≈ 120k in + 18k out (+ optional 1 daily consolidation call 20k in / 4k out). Idle cycles cost $0.
751	
752	| Setup | Expected / month | Heavy usage (×3) |
753	|---|---|---|
754	| **Haiku 5.5 or gpt-6-luna only** | **≈ $0.70** | ≈ $2 |
755	| **Recommended: Haiku/luna per cycle + Sonnet/sol daily consolidation** | **≈ $3** | ≈ $9 |
756	| Sonnet 5.5 or gpt-6.1-sol for everything | ≈ $15 | ≈ $45 |
757	| Opus 5.5 for everything | ≈ $30 | ≈ $90 |

========== bin/memo.js ==========
#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

const HELP = `memo init                         set up memory in this repo (also registers it for capture)
memo note -t decision "text"      log a decision (also: error, next)
memo note --personal "text"       save a fact about you (~/.memo)
memo brief                        regenerate .memory/BRIEF.md
memo setup claude                 add MEMO capture hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json
     [--dry-run] [--remove] [--shell-form]
memo capture                      (internal) Claude Code hook entry, reads hook JSON on stdin
memo capture --sweep              catch up all registered repos from stored cursors
memo hook                         (internal) called by git post-commit
`;

async function main(argv) {
  const cmd = argv[2];
  switch (cmd) {
    case 'init':
      require('../src/init.js')();
      break;
    case 'note':
      require('../src/note.js')(argv.slice(3));
      break;
    case 'hook':
      require('../src/hook.js')();
      break;
    case 'brief':
      require('../src/brief.js').command();
      break;
    case 'setup':
      if (argv[3] !== 'claude') {
        process.stderr.write('usage: memo setup claude [--dry-run] [--remove] [--shell-form]\n');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }
      require('../src/capture/install-claude.js').setupClaude(argv.slice(4));
      break;
    case 'capture':
      // Hook path: never print errors, always exit 0.
      await require('../src/capture/capture.js').command(argv.slice(3));
      process.exit(0);
      break;
    case '--help':
    case '-h':
    case undefined:
      process.stdout.write(HELP);
      break;
    default:
      process.stderr.write(HELP);
      process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}

main(process.argv).catch((err) => {
  if (process.argv[2] === 'capture') process.exit(0);
  if (process.env.MEMO_DEBUG === '1') {
    console.error(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
  } else {
    console.error('memo: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
  }
  process.exit(1);
});

========== src/util.js ==========
'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');

function sha1(text) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha1').update(String(text)).digest('hex');
}

function fwd(p) {
  return String(p).replace(/\\/g, '/');
}

function writeFileAtomic(filePath, content) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  const tmp = `${filePath}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, content, 'utf8');
  fs.renameSync(tmp, filePath);
}

function writeJsonAtomic(filePath, value) {
  writeFileAtomic(filePath, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n');
}

function readJson(filePath, fallback) {
  let raw;
  try {
    raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return fallback;
    throw err;
  }
  return JSON.parse(raw);
}

function pad(n, w = 2) {
  return String(n).padStart(w, '0');
}

// ISO 8601 in local time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-22T14:03:11.120+05:30
function isoLocal(input) {
  const d = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input || Date.now());
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return isoLocal(new Date());
  const off = -d.getTimezoneOffset();
  const sign = off >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
  const abs = Math.abs(off);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}` +
    `T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}.${pad(d.getMilliseconds(), 3)}` +
    `${sign}${pad(Math.floor(abs / 60))}:${pad(abs % 60)}`;
}

// Local calendar date YYYY-MM-DD
function localDate(input) {
  return isoLocal(input).slice(0, 10);
}

function sleepMs(ms) {
  Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, ms);
}

module.exports = { sha1, fwd, writeFileAtomic, writeJsonAtomic, readJson, isoLocal, localDate, sleepMs };

========== src/repos.js ==========
'use strict';

const path = require('node:path');
const { memoHome } = require('./paths');
const { sha1, fwd, readJson, writeJsonAtomic, isoLocal } = require('./util');

function registryPath() {
  return path.join(memoHome(), 'repos.json');
}

// Comparable form of a repo root: forward slashes, no trailing slash,
// case-insensitive for Windows drive paths.
function normRoot(root) {
  let p = fwd(path.resolve(root)).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (process.platform === 'win32' || /^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(p)) p = p.toLowerCase();
  return p;
}

function repoId(root) {
  const slug = path.basename(path.resolve(root)).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '-').slice(0, 40) || 'repo';
  return `${slug}-${sha1(normRoot(root)).slice(0, 8)}`;
}

function load() {
  const list = readJson(registryPath(), []);
  return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
}

function find(root) {
  const key = normRoot(root);
  return load().find((r) => normRoot(r.root) === key) || null;
}

function register(root) {
  const list = load();
  const key = normRoot(root);
  const existing = list.find((r) => normRoot(r.root) === key);
  if (existing) return { status: 'skipped', repo: existing };
  const repo = { id: repoId(root), root: fwd(path.resolve(root)), addedAt: isoLocal(), enabled: true };
  list.push(repo);
  writeJsonAtomic(registryPath(), list);
  return { status: 'created', repo };
}

module.exports = { registryPath, normRoot, repoId, load, find, register };

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { logsDir } = require('./paths');
const { isoLocal } = require('./util');

const MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

// Append one JSON line to ~/.memo/logs/<name>.jsonl. Never throws.
function log(name, fields) {
  try {
    const dir = logsDir();
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const file = path.join(dir, `${name}.jsonl`);
    try {
      if (fs.statSync(file).size > MAX_BYTES) fs.renameSync(file, `${file}.1`);
    } catch (_) { /* missing file is fine */ }
    fs.appendFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ ts: isoLocal(), ...fields }) + '\n', 'utf8');
  } catch (_) {
    // Logging must never break a hook or a commit.
  }
}

module.exports = { log, MAX_BYTES };

========== src/lock.js ==========
'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { sleepMs } = require('./util');

// Exclusive lock file. Returns { release, recovered } or null when busy.
// A lock older than staleMs is taken over (recovered: true).
function acquire(lockPath, { staleMs = 60000, waitMs = 0 } = {}) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(lockPath), { recursive: true });
  const deadline = Date.now() + waitMs;
  let recovered = false;
  for (;;) {
    try {
      const fd = fs.openSync(lockPath, 'wx');
      fs.writeSync(fd, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() }));
      fs.closeSync(fd);
      let released = false;
      return {
        recovered,
        release() {
          if (released) return;
          released = true;
          try { fs.unlinkSync(lockPath); } catch (_) { /* already gone */ }
        }
      };
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code !== 'EEXIST') throw err;
    }
    let age = 0;
    try { age = Date.now() - fs.statSync(lockPath).mtimeMs; } catch (_) { continue; }
    if (age > staleMs) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(lockPath); recovered = true; } catch (_) { /* raced */ }
      continue;
    }
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) return null;
    sleepMs(50);
  }
}

module.exports = { acquire };

========== src/store/sessions.js ==========
'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { sessionsDir } = require('../paths');
const { readJson, writeJsonAtomic } = require('../util');

const SID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/;

function validSid(sid) {
  return typeof sid === 'string' && SID_RE.test(sid);
}

function indexPath(root) {
  return path.join(sessionsDir(root), 'index.json');
}

function loadIndex(root) {
  const list = readJson(indexPath(root), []);
  return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
}

function saveIndex(root, list) {
  writeJsonAtomic(indexPath(root), list);
}

// .memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl
function sessionFile(root, date, sid) {
  if (!validSid(sid)) throw new Error(`invalid session id: ${sid}`);
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) throw new Error(`invalid date: ${date}`);
  const [y, m, d] = date.split('-');
  return path.join(sessionsDir(root), y, m, d, `${sid}.jsonl`);
}

// Ids and last seq already in a session file (for dedup + continuous seq).
function readExisting(file) {
  const ids = new Set();
  let lastSeq = 0;
  let raw;
  try { raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return { ids, lastSeq };
    throw err;
  }
  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (!line) continue;
    try {
      const e = JSON.parse(line);
      if (e.id) ids.add(e.id);
      if (typeof e.seq === 'number' && e.seq > lastSeq) lastSeq = e.seq;
    } catch (_) { /* a torn line is ignored; dedup still works for the rest */ }
  }
  return { ids, lastSeq };
}

// Append complete lines and fsync.
function appendEvents(file, events) {
  if (events.length === 0) return;
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const data = events.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n') + '\n';
  const fd = fs.openSync(file, 'a');
  try {
    fs.writeSync(fd, data, null, 'utf8');
    fs.fsyncSync(fd);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
}

module.exports = { validSid, indexPath, loadIndex, saveIndex, sessionFile, readExisting, appendEvents };

========== src/redact.js ==========
'use strict';

const PATTERNS = [
  { regex: /-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----/g },
  { regex: /sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g },
  { regex: /sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g },
  { regex: /sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}/g },
  { regex: /gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g },
  { regex: /github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}/g },
  { regex: /AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}/g },
  { regex: /AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35,}/g },
  { regex: /xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}/g },
  { regex: /eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+/g },
  { regex: /Bearer\s+\S+/gi },
  // scheme://user:pass@host → scheme://[REDACTED]@host
  { regex: /\b([A-Za-z][\w+.-]*):\/\/[^\s:@/]+:[^\s@/]+@/g, replace: (m, scheme) => `${scheme}://[REDACTED]@` },
  // .env style lines: NAME=value (value ≥ 8 chars)
  { regex: /^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,})=(?!\[REDACTED\])\S{8,}$/gm, replace: (m, name) => `${name}=[REDACTED]` },
  // long base64/hex tokens shortly after the words key / secret / token
  {
    regex: /\b(key|secret|token)\b([^\n]{0,20}?)([A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{40,})/gi,
    replace: (m, word, mid) => `${word}${mid}[REDACTED]`
  },
  {
    regex: /\b(password|passwd|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\s*([:=])\s*(?!\[REDACTED\])(\S+)/gi,
    replace: (m, label, sep) => `${label}${sep}[REDACTED]`
  }
];

const DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS = ['.env', '.env.*', '*.pem', '*.key', 'id_rsa*', 'credentials*.json', 'secrets/**'];

function redact(text) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string') return { text: '', count: 0 };
  let count = 0;
  let redacted = text;
  for (const pattern of PATTERNS) {
    redacted = redacted.replace(pattern.regex, (...args) => {
      count++;
      return pattern.replace ? pattern.replace(...args) : '[REDACTED]';
    });
  }
  return { text: redacted, count };
}

function globToRegex(glob) {
  let re = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < glob.length; i++) {
    const c = glob[i];
    if (c === '*' && glob[i + 1] === '*') { re += '.*'; i++; }
    else if (c === '*') re += '[^/]*';
    else if (c === '?') re += '[^/]';
    else re += c.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  }
  return new RegExp(`^${re}$`, 'i');
}

// true → the path matches a deny pattern and everything about it must be dropped.
// Patterns without "/" match any path segment; patterns with "/" match from any segment start.
function redactPath(relPath, denyPaths = DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS) {
  if (typeof relPath !== 'string' || !relPath) return false;
  const parts = relPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  for (const glob of denyPaths) {
    const re = globToRegex(glob);
    if (glob.includes('/')) {
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) if (re.test(parts.slice(i).join('/'))) return true;
    } else if (parts.some((seg) => re.test(seg))) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

module.exports = { redact, redactPath, DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS };

'use strict';

// `memo capture` — Claude Code hook entry point and `--sweep` catch-up.
// Reads new transcript bytes since the stored offset, normalizes, redacts,
// appends to .memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl. Never fails the caller.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { stateDir, memoHome } = require('../paths');
const { repoRoot } = require('../git');
const repos = require('../repos');
const { acquire } = require('../lock');
const { log } = require('../log');
const { readJson, writeJsonAtomic, localDate } = require('../util');
const { DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS } = require('../redact');
const { normalize } = require('./claude');
const sessions = require('../store/sessions');

const STDIN_MAX = 1024 * 1024;
const STDIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;
const MAX_TOOL_IDS = 500;

function readStdin() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (process.stdin.isTTY) return resolve('');
    const chunks = [];
    let size = 0;
    let done = false;
    const finish = () => {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      process.stdin.pause();
      resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(finish, STDIN_TIMEOUT_MS);
    process.stdin.on('data', (c) => {
      size += c.length;
      if (size > STDIN_MAX) return finish();
      chunks.push(c);
    });
    process.stdin.on('end', finish);
    process.stdin.on('error', finish);
  });
}

function loadDenyPaths() {
  try {
    const cfg = readJson(path.join(memoHome(), 'config.json'), null);
    if (cfg && Array.isArray(cfg.denyPaths)) return cfg.denyPaths;
  } catch (_) { /* bad config → defaults */ }
  return DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS;
}

function cursorsPath(repoId) {
  return path.join(stateDir(repoId), 'cursors.json');
}

function trimTools(tools) {
  const keys = Object.keys(tools);
  if (keys.length <= MAX_TOOL_IDS) return tools;
  const out = {};
  for (const k of keys.slice(-MAX_TOOL_IDS)) out[k] = tools[k];
  return out;
}

function readRange(file, start, end) {
  const len = end - start;
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(len);
  const fd = fs.openSync(file, 'r');
  try {
    let read = 0;
    while (read < len) {
      const n = fs.readSync(fd, buf, read, len - read, start + read);
      if (n === 0) break;
      read += n;
    }
    return buf.subarray(0, read);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
}

/**
 * Capture one session of one registered repo.
 * @returns {{status: string, newEvents: number}}
 */
function captureSession({ repo, sid, transcriptPath, event = 'sweep', source, lockWaitMs = 1500 }) {
  const root = repo.root;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const sid8 = String(sid).slice(0, 8);
  if (!sessions.validSid(sid)) {
    log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, status: 'invalid_sid' });
    return { status: 'invalid_sid', newEvents: 0 };
  }
  const lock = acquire(path.join(stateDir(repo.id), 'capture.lock'), { staleMs: 60000, waitMs: lockWaitMs });
  if (!lock) {
    log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'busy' });
    return { status: 'busy', newEvents: 0 };
  }
  if (lock.recovered) log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'stale_lock_recovered' });
  try {
    const cPath = cursorsPath(repo.id);
    const cursors = readJson(cPath, {});
    let cur = cursors[sid];
    const tPath = transcriptPath || (cur && cur.transcriptPath);
    const index = sessions.loadIndex(root);
    const before = JSON.stringify(index);
    let entry = index.find((e) => e.sid === sid);

    const setStatus = () => {
      if (!entry) return;
      if (event === 'SessionEnd') entry.status = 'ended';
      else if (event === 'SessionStart' || (entry.status === 'transcript_missing' && event !== 'sweep')) entry.status = 'active';
    };
    const saveIndexIfChanged = () => {
      if (JSON.stringify(index) !== before) sessions.saveIndex(root, index);
    };

    let stat = null;
    if (tPath) {
      try { stat = fs.statSync(tPath); } catch (_) { stat = null; }
    }
    if (!stat) {
      // SessionStart may fire before the transcript file exists: remember the path, no gap.
      if (tPath && (!cur || cur.transcriptPath !== tPath)) {
        cursors[sid] = { ...(cur || { offset: 0, lineNo: 0, tools: {} }), transcriptPath: tPath };
        writeJsonAtomic(cPath, cursors);
      }
      let status = tPath ? 'transcript_missing' : 'no_transcript';
      if (event === 'SessionStart' && !entry) status = 'waiting_for_transcript';
      else if (entry && event !== 'SessionEnd') entry.status = 'transcript_missing';
      setStatus();
      saveIndexIfChanged();
      log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
      return { status, newEvents: 0 };
    }

    if (!cur) cur = { transcriptPath: tPath, offset: 0, lineNo: 0, tools: {} };
    cur.transcriptPath = tPath;
    cur.tools = cur.tools || {};
    let status = 'ok';
    if (stat.size < cur.offset) {
      log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'transcript_rewritten', oldOffset: cur.offset, size: stat.size });
      cur.offset = 0;
      cur.lineNo = 0;
      status = 'transcript_rewritten';
    }

    const envelopes = [];
    let badLines = 0;
    let consumed = 0;
    if (stat.size > cur.offset) {
      const buf = readRange(tPath, cur.offset, stat.size);
      const lastNl = buf.lastIndexOf(0x0a);
      if (lastNl >= 0) {
        consumed = lastNl + 1;
        const text = buf.subarray(0, consumed).toString('utf8');
        const ctx = { sid, root, cwd: root, home: os.homedir(), tools: cur.tools, denyPaths: loadDenyPaths() };
        for (const rawLine of text.slice(0, -1).split('\n')) {
          cur.lineNo++;
          const raw = rawLine.replace(/\r$/, '');
          if (!raw.trim()) continue;
          let obj;
          try { obj = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {
            badLines++;
            log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'bad_line', line: cur.lineNo });
            continue;
          }
          ctx.lineNo = cur.lineNo;
          ctx.raw = raw;
          for (const env of normalize(obj, ctx)) envelopes.push(env);
        }
      }
      // bytes after the last "\n" are an incomplete line: left for the next run
    }

    let added = [];
    if (envelopes.length > 0) {
      const date = entry ? entry.date : localDate(envelopes[0].ts);
      const file = sessions.sessionFile(root, date, sid);
      const existing = sessions.readExisting(file);
      let seq = existing.lastSeq;
      for (const env of envelopes) {
        if (existing.ids.has(env.id)) continue;
        existing.ids.add(env.id);
        seq++;
        const { v, id, sid: s, ts, agent, type, ...rest } = env;
        added.push({ v, id, sid: s, seq, ts, agent, type, ...rest });
      }
      sessions.appendEvents(file, added);
      if (added.length > 0) {
        if (!entry) {
          entry = { sid, agent: 'claude-code', date, start: added[0].ts, end: added[0].ts, events: 0, processedThrough: 0, summary: '', status: 'active' };
          index.push(entry);
        }
        entry.events = seq;
        entry.end = added[added.length - 1].ts;
      }
    }

    cur.offset += consumed;
    cur.fileSize = stat.size;
    if (added.length > 0) cur.lastEventId = added[added.length - 1].id;
    cur.tools = trimTools(cur.tools);
    cursors[sid] = cur;
    writeJsonAtomic(cPath, cursors);

    setStatus();
    saveIndexIfChanged();
    log('capture', { event, source, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status, newEvents: added.length, badLines, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
    return { status, newEvents: added.length };
  } finally {
    lock.release();
  }
}

function sweep() {
  const results = [];
  for (const repo of repos.load()) {
    if (!repo.enabled) continue;
    let cursors = {};
    try { cursors = readJson(cursorsPath(repo.id), {}); } catch (err) {
      log('capture', { event: 'sweep', repo: repo.id, status: 'bad_cursors', error: err.message });
      continue;
    }
    for (const sid of Object.keys(cursors)) {
      try {
        results.push({ repo: repo.id, sid, ...captureSession({ repo, sid, event: 'sweep', lockWaitMs: 5000 }) });
      } catch (err) {
        log('capture', { event: 'sweep', repo: repo.id, sid: sid.slice(0, 8), status: 'error', error: err.message });
        results.push({ repo: repo.id, sid, status: 'error', newEvents: 0 });
      }
    }
  }
  return results;
}

async function hookEntry() {
  const raw = await readStdin();
  let data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {
    log('capture', { event: 'unknown', status: 'bad_stdin', bytes: raw.length });
    return;
  }
  const event = String(data.hook_event_name || 'unknown');
  const cwd = data.cwd || process.cwd();
  let root;
  try { root = repoRoot(cwd); } catch (_) {
    log('capture', { event, status: 'skip_not_git' });
    return;
  }
  const repo = repos.find(root);
  if (!repo || repo.enabled === false) {
    log('capture', { event, status: 'skip_unregistered' });
    return;
  }
  captureSession({
    repo,
    sid: data.session_id,
    transcriptPath: data.transcript_path,
    event,
    source: data.source || data.reason,
    lockWaitMs: event === 'SessionEnd' ? 800 : 1500
  });
}

// CLI: always resolves, never throws.
async function command(argv = []) {
  try {
    if (argv.includes('--sweep')) {
      const results = sweep();
      const total = results.reduce((n, r) => n + (r.newEvents || 0), 0);
      if (process.stdout.isTTY || argv.includes('--verbose')) {
        console.log(`swept ${results.length} session(s), ${total} new event(s)`);
      }
      return;
    }
    await hookEntry();
  } catch (err) {
    log('capture', { status: 'error', error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err) });
  }
}

module.exports = { command, captureSession, sweep, readStdin };

'use strict';

// Claude Code transcript line → MEMO event envelopes (§6.1).
// The transcript format is not a documented contract: be tolerant, drop what is unknown.

const { redact, redactPath, DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS } = require('../redact');
const { sha1, isoLocal } = require('../util');

const LIMITS = { user_prompt: 4000, assistant_text: 3000, tool_call: 300, system: 300 };
const RESULT_HEAD = 500;
const RESULT_TAIL = 300;
const FILE_TOOLS = new Set(['Read', 'Write', 'Edit', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit', 'NotebookRead']);
const CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS = new Set(['Read', 'NotebookRead']); // results dropped entirely
const WRITE_TOOLS = new Set(['Write', 'Edit', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit']); // results reduced to ok/error

function cut(text, max) {
  if (text.length <= max) return { text, truncated: false };
  return { text: text.slice(0, max), truncated: true };
}

function cutResult(text) {
  if (text.length <= RESULT_HEAD + RESULT_TAIL) return { text, truncated: false };
  return { text: `${text.slice(0, RESULT_HEAD)}\n…\n${text.slice(-RESULT_TAIL)}`, truncated: true };
}

function isWinAbs(p) { return /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(p); }
function isAbs(p) { return p.startsWith('/') || p.startsWith('\\\\') || isWinAbs(p); }
function slashes(p) { return String(p).replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, ''); }
function cmpKey(p) { return isWinAbs(p) ? slashes(p).toLowerCase() : slashes(p); }

// Repo-relative forward-slash path, "<outside-repo>" for anything outside, null if unusable.
function relPath(p, ctx) {
  if (typeof p !== 'string' || !p.trim()) return null;
  let abs = p.trim();
  if (!isAbs(abs)) {
    if (!ctx.cwd) return slashes(abs).split('/').includes('..') ? '<outside-repo>' : slashes(abs);
    abs = `${slashes(ctx.cwd)}/${abs}`;
  }
  const parts = [];
  for (const seg of slashes(abs).split('/')) {
    if (seg === '..') parts.pop();
    else if (seg !== '.') parts.push(seg);
  }
  const full = parts.join('/');
  const root = cmpKey(ctx.root);
  const key = cmpKey(full);
  if (key === root) return '.';
  if (!key.startsWith(root + '/')) return '<outside-repo>';
  return full.slice(slashes(ctx.root).length + 1);
}

// Checked on the raw path too, so a denied file outside the repo is also dropped.
function denied(raw, ctx) {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return false;
  return redactPath(slashes(raw).replace(/^[A-Za-z]:/, ''), ctx.denyPaths || DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS);
}

// Hide absolute machine paths inside free text.
function scrubPaths(text, ctx) {
  let out = text;
  const swap = (base, label) => {
    if (!base) return;
    const variants = new Set([base, base.replace(/\//g, '\\'), base.replace(/\\/g, '/')]);
    for (const v of variants) {
      if (v.length < 4) continue;
      const re = new RegExp(v.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), isWinAbs(v) ? 'gi' : 'g');
      out = out.replace(re, label);
    }
  };
  swap(ctx.root, '<repo>');
  swap(ctx.home, '~');
  return out;
}

function stripReminders(text) {
  return text.replace(/<system-reminder>[\s\S]*?<\/system-reminder>/g, '').trim();
}

function contentText(content) {
  if (typeof content === 'string') return content;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return '';
  return content.filter((c) => c && c.type === 'text' && typeof c.text === 'string').map((c) => c.text).join('\n');
}

function countLines(s) {
  return typeof s === 'string' && s ? s.split('\n').length : 0;
}

// Short description of a tool call + the paths it touches.
function describeToolUse(name, input, ctx) {
  const inp = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {};
  const paths = [];
  let text;
  if (FILE_TOOLS.has(name)) {
    const p = inp.file_path || inp.notebook_path || inp.path;
    const rel = relPath(p, ctx);
    if (typeof p === 'string') paths.push(p);
    text = rel || '(no path)';
    if (name === 'Write') text += ` (${countLines(inp.content)} lines)`;
    if (name === 'Edit') text += ` (-${countLines(inp.old_string)} +${countLines(inp.new_string)} lines)`;
    if (name === 'MultiEdit' && Array.isArray(inp.edits)) text += ` (${inp.edits.length} edits)`;
  } else if (name === 'Bash' || name === 'PowerShell') {
    text = String(inp.command || '');
    for (const tok of text.split(/[\s"'`;|&<>()=]+/)) {
      if (tok && /[./\\]/.test(tok)) paths.push(tok);
    }
  } else if (name === 'Glob' || name === 'Grep') {
    const rel = inp.path ? relPath(inp.path, ctx) : null;
    if (typeof inp.path === 'string') paths.push(inp.path);
    text = `${inp.pattern || ''}${rel ? ` in ${rel}` : ''}`;
  } else if (name === 'WebFetch') {
    text = String(inp.url || '');
  } else if (name === 'WebSearch') {
    text = String(inp.query || '');
  } else if (name === 'Task' || name === 'Agent') {
    text = String(inp.description || inp.subagent_type || '');
  } else if (name === 'TodoWrite' && Array.isArray(inp.todos)) {
    text = inp.todos.map((t) => `[${t.status || '?'}] ${t.content || ''}`).join('; ');
  } else {
    try { text = JSON.stringify(inp); } catch (_) { text = ''; }
  }
  return { text, paths };
}

function makeId(sid, line, raw, blockIndex) {
  return `e-${sha1(`${sid}${line.uuid || raw}${blockIndex}`).slice(0, 8)}`;
}

function finish(env, limit, ctx) {
  const scrubbed = scrubPaths(env.text, ctx);
  const red = redact(scrubbed).text;
  const c = env.type === 'tool_result' ? cutResult(red) : cut(red, limit);
  env.text = redact(c.text).text;
  if (c.truncated) env.truncated = true;
  return env;
}

/**
 * @param {object} line parsed transcript line
 * @param {object} ctx  { sid, root, cwd, home, lineNo, raw, tools: {toolUseId: [name, denied]}, denyPaths }
 *                      ctx.tools is mutated (tool_use ids remembered for their later results).
 * @returns {object[]} envelopes without seq
 */
function normalize(line, ctx) {
  if (!line || typeof line !== 'object') return [];
  if (line.isSidechain === true) return []; // subagent transcripts: not captured in MVP
  const out = [];
  const tools = ctx.tools || (ctx.tools = {});
  const lctx = { ...ctx, cwd: line.cwd || ctx.cwd };
  const base = (blockIndex, type) => {
    const env = { v: 1, id: makeId(ctx.sid, line, ctx.raw || '', blockIndex), sid: ctx.sid, ts: isoLocal(line.timestamp), agent: 'claude-code', type };
    return env;
  };
  const src = () => ({ line: ctx.lineNo, ...(line.uuid ? { uuid: line.uuid } : {}) });

  if (line.type === 'system') {
    if (line.subtype === 'compact_boundary') {
      out.push({ ...base(0, 'system'), text: 'context compacted', src: src() });
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (line.type !== 'user' && line.type !== 'assistant') return out;
  const msg = line.message && typeof line.message === 'object' ? line.message : {};
  const content = msg.content;

  if (line.type === 'user') {
    if (line.isMeta === true) return out;
    if (line.isCompactSummary === true) return out; // model-written summary; compact_boundary marks the event
    const items = typeof content === 'string' ? [{ type: 'text', text: content }] : Array.isArray(content) ? content : [];
    const texts = [];
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
      if (item.type === 'text' && typeof item.text === 'string') {
        texts.push(item.text);
      } else if (item.type === 'tool_result') {
        const known = tools[item.tool_use_id];
        const name = known ? known[0] : null;
        if (known && known[1]) return; // denied path
        if (name && CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS.has(name)) return; // never store file contents
        const env = { ...base(i, 'tool_result') };
        if (name) env.tool = name;
        if (item.is_error === true) env.ok = false;
        else if (item.is_error === false) env.ok = true;
        let text = contentText(item.content);
        if (name && WRITE_TOOLS.has(name)) text = env.ok === false ? text : 'ok';
        env.text = text;
        env.src = src();
        out.push(finish(env, 0, lctx));
      }
    });
    let text = stripReminders(texts.join('\n'));
    if (!text) return out;
    if (/<local-command-stdout>|<local-command-stderr>/.test(text)) return out;
    const cmd = text.match(/<command-name>([\s\S]*?)<\/command-name>/);
    if (cmd) {
      const args = (text.match(/<command-args>([\s\S]*?)<\/command-args>/) || [])[1] || '';
      out.unshift(finish({ ...base('cmd', 'system'), text: `command ${cmd[1].trim()} ${args.trim()}`.trim(), src: src() }, LIMITS.system, lctx));
      return out;
    }
    if (/^\[Request interrupted by user/.test(text)) {
      out.unshift({ ...base('int', 'system'), text: 'interrupted by user', src: src() });
      return out;
    }
    out.unshift(finish({ ...base('text', 'user_prompt'), text, src: src() }, LIMITS.user_prompt, lctx));
    return out;
  }

  // assistant
  const items = typeof content === 'string' ? [{ type: 'text', text: content }] : Array.isArray(content) ? content : [];
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
    const blockIndex = typeof line.apiBlockIndex === 'number' ? `${line.apiBlockIndex}.${i}` : i;
    if (item.type === 'text' && typeof item.text === 'string' && item.text.trim()) {
      out.push(finish({ ...base(blockIndex, 'assistant_text'), text: item.text.trim(), src: src() }, LIMITS.assistant_text, lctx));
    } else if (item.type === 'tool_use') {
      const name = String(item.name || 'unknown');
      const { text, paths } = describeToolUse(name, item.input, lctx);
      const isDenied = paths.some((p) => denied(p, lctx));
      if (item.id) tools[item.id] = isDenied ? [name, 1] : [name];
      if (isDenied) return;
      out.push(finish({ ...base(blockIndex, 'tool_call'), tool: name, text, src: src() }, LIMITS.tool_call, lctx));
    }
    // thinking, redacted_thinking, image, anything else: dropped
  });
  return out;
}

module.exports = { normalize, relPath, LIMITS };

========== src/git.js ==========
'use strict';

const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
const path = require('path');

function run(args, cwd) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function repoRoot(cwd) {
  try {
    return run(['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], cwd);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error('Not inside a git repo');
  }
}

function hooksDir(root) {
  const p = run(['rev-parse', '--git-path', 'hooks'], root);
  return path.resolve(root, p);
}

function lastCommit(root) {
  const output = run(['log', '-1', '--format=%h%x1f%s'], root);
  const separator = output.indexOf('\x1f');
  if (separator === -1) throw new Error('Unable to read last commit');
  return { hash: output.slice(0, separator), subject: output.slice(separator + 1) };
}

function changedFiles(root) {
  const output = run([
    'diff-tree', '--root', '--no-commit-id', '--numstat', '-r', 'HEAD'
  ], root);
  if (!output) return [];
  return output.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
    const parts = line.split('\t');
    if (parts.length < 3) return null;
    return { added: parts[0], deleted: parts[1], file: parts.slice(2).join('\t') };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

module.exports = { run, repoRoot, hooksDir, lastCommit, changedFiles };

=== src/init.js ===
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { repoRoot, hooksDir } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir, memoBin, sessionsDir } = require('./paths');
const repos = require('./repos');

const MEMORY_FILES = {
  'progress.md': '# Progress\n\n(auto-written by the post-commit hook)\n',
  'decisions.md': '# Decisions\n',
  'errors.md': '# Errors\n',
  'next.md': '# Next\n'
};

const AGENTS_LINE = 'Read .memory/BRIEF.md before starting.';
const GITIGNORE_LINE = '.memory/BRIEF.md';
const HOOK_MARK = '# memo-hook';

function createOnly(filePath, content) {
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) return 'skipped';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
  return 'created';
}

function appendLineIfAbsent(filePath, line) {
  let existing = '';
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) existing = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  if (existing.split(/\r?\n/).includes(line)) return 'skipped';
  const prefix = existing && !existing.endsWith('\n') ? '\n' : '';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync(filePath, prefix + line + '\n', 'utf8');
  return 'created';
}

function hookContent() {
  const template = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(__dirname, '..', 'templates', 'post-commit'),
    'utf8'
  );
  const fwd = (p) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  return template
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
    .replace('{{NODE}}', fwd(process.execPath))
    .replace('{{MEMO}}', fwd(memoBin()));
}

function installHook(root) {
  const hookPath = path.join(hooksDir(root), 'post-commit');
  if (fs.existsSync(hookPath)) {
    const existing = fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8');
    if (existing.includes(HOOK_MARK)) return 'skipped';
    const normalized = existing.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
    const sep = normalized.endsWith('\n') ? '\n' : '\n\n';
    fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, normalized + sep + hookContent(), 'utf8');
    return 'created';
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(hookPath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, hookContent(), { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o755 });
  return 'created';
}

function init() {
  const root = repoRoot(process.cwd());
  const report = [];

  for (const [name, content] of Object.entries(MEMORY_FILES)) {
    const status = createOnly(path.join(memoryDir(root), name), content);
    report.push([status, `.memory/${name}`]);
  }

  const agentsPath = path.join(root, 'AGENTS.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(agentsPath)) {
    fs.writeFileSync(agentsPath, AGENTS_LINE + '\n', 'utf8');
    report.push(['created', 'AGENTS.md']);
  } else {
    report.push([appendLineIfAbsent(agentsPath, AGENTS_LINE), 'AGENTS.md']);
  }

  report.push([appendLineIfAbsent(path.join(root, '.gitignore'), GITIGNORE_LINE), '.gitignore']);

  report.push([installHook(root), 'post-commit hook']);

  const sDir = sessionsDir(root);
  report.push([fs.existsSync(sDir) ? 'skipped' : 'created', '.memory/sessions/']);
  fs.mkdirSync(sDir, { recursive: true });

  const reg = repos.register(root);
  report.push([reg.status, `repo registered (${reg.repo.id})`]);

  for (const [status, name] of report) {
    console.log(`${status}  ${name}`);
  }
}

module.exports = init;

=== src/brief.js ===
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir, memoHome } = require('./paths');

const MAX_LINES = 150;

function pad(n) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

function getLocalTimestamp() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

function parseEntries(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return [];
  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  return content
    .split(/(?=^## )/gm)
    .map(p => p.trim())
    .filter(p => p.startsWith('## '))
    .reverse();
}

function readAboutMe() {
  const personalPath = path.join(memoHome(), 'personal.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(personalPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(personalPath, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(l => l.trim() !== '' && !l.startsWith('# '))
    .slice(0, 20);
}

function readOpenNext(memDir) {
  const nextPath = path.join(memDir, 'next.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(nextPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(nextPath, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(l => l.startsWith('- [ ] '));
}

function buildBrief(root) {
  const memDir = memoryDir(root);
  const repoName = path.basename(root);
  const timestamp = getLocalTimestamp();
  const aboutMe = readAboutMe();

  const commits = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'progress.md')).slice(0, 10);
  const decisions = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'decisions.md')).slice(0, 10);
  const errors = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'errors.md')).slice(0, 5);
  const next = readOpenNext(memDir);

  function section(title, items, sep) {
    return [`## ${title}`, items.length > 0 ? items.join(sep) : '(none yet)', ''];
  }

  function assemble() {
    const lines = [
      `# BRIEF — ${repoName}`,
      `Generated ${timestamp} by memo. Do not edit; run \`memo brief\`.`,
      '',
    ];
    if (aboutMe.length > 0) lines.push('## About me', ...aboutMe, '');
    lines.push(...section('Open next steps', next, '\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent decisions (last 10)', decisions, '\n\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent errors (last 5)', errors, '\n\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent commits (last 10)', commits, '\n\n'));
    return lines.join('\n').trimEnd() + '\n';
  }

  let text = assemble();
  while (text.split('\n').length - 1 > MAX_LINES) {
    if (commits.length > 0) commits.pop();
    else if (decisions.length > 0) decisions.pop();
    else if (errors.length > 0) errors.pop();
    else if (next.length > 1) next.pop();
    else if (next.length === 1 && next[0] !== '…truncated in next.md') next[0] = '…truncated in next.md';
    else break;
    text = assemble();
  }
  return text;
}

function command() {
  let root;
  try {
    root = repoRoot(process.cwd());
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const memDir = memoryDir(root);
  if (!fs.existsSync(memDir)) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const content = buildBrief(root);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(memDir, 'BRIEF.md'), content, 'utf8');
  console.log(`BRIEF.md written (${content.split('\n').length - 1} lines)`);
}

module.exports = { buildBrief, command };

=== test/capture-incremental.test.js ===
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');
const FIX = path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures', 'claude');
const HAS_GIT = !spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error;
const SKIP = !HAS_GIT && 'git not installed';

function setup(t, { repoName = 'repo', init = true } = {}) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-cap-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, repoName);
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  const transcripts = path.join(base, 'transcripts');
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.mkdirSync(transcripts);
  const env = { ...process.env, MEMO_HOME: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1' };
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, env });
  const memo = (args, input) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env, input
  });
  if (init) assert.equal(memo(['init']).status, 0);
  return { base, root, home, transcripts, memo, env };
}

function fixtureLines(name) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(FIX, `${name}.jsonl`), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

function hook(ctx, { sid, tPath, event = 'Stop', cwd, extra = {} }) {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ session_id: sid, transcript_path: tPath, cwd: cwd || ctx.root, hook_event_name: event, ...extra });
  const r = ctx.memo(['capture'], payload);
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.equal(r.stderr, '');
  return r;
}

function sessionEvents(root) {
  const dir = path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions');
  const out = [];
  const walk = (d) => {
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const p = path.join(d, f.name);
      if (f.isDirectory()) walk(p);
      else if (f.name.endsWith('.jsonl')) out.push({ file: p, events: fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l)) });
    }
  };
  if (fs.existsSync(dir)) walk(dir);
  return out;
}

function index(root) {
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), 'utf8'));
}

function assertContinuous(events) {
  events.forEach((e, i) => assert.equal(e.seq, i + 1));
  assert.equal(new Set(events.map((e) => e.id)).size, events.length, 'duplicate ids');
}

const SID = 'aaaaaaaa-1111-4222-8333-444444444444';

test('incremental capture: half then rest → no duplicates, continuous seq, YYYY/MM/DD path', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const lines = fixtureLines('basic');
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const half = Math.floor(lines.length / 2);
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(0, half).join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, event: 'SessionStart', extra: { source: 'startup' } });
  const first = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events.length;
  assert.ok(first > 0);
  fs.appendFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(half).join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath }); // replay: nothing new
  const files = sessionEvents(ctx.root);
  assert.equal(files.length, 1);
  assert.equal(files[0].events.length, 11);
  assertContinuous(files[0].events);
  const rel = path.relative(path.join(ctx.root, '.memory', 'sessions'), files[0].file).split(path.sep);
  assert.equal(rel.length, 4);
  assert.match(rel.slice(0, 3).join('/'), /^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}$/);
  assert.equal(rel[3], `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const idx = index(ctx.root);
  assert.equal(idx.length, 1);
  assert.equal(idx[0].events, 11);
  assert.equal(idx[0].status, 'active');
  assert.equal(idx[0].processedThrough, 0);
});

test('partial last line is held back until complete', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const lines = fixtureLines('error-then-fix');
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const all = lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  const cutAt = all.indexOf(lines[3]) + 20; // middle of line 4
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, all.slice(0, cutAt));
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  const n1 = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events.length;
  fs.appendFileSync(tPath, all.slice(cutAt));
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  const ev = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events;
  assert.ok(ev.length > n1);
  assert.equal(ev.length, 11);
  assertContinuous(ev);
  const log = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ctx.home, 'logs', 'capture.jsonl'), 'utf8');
  assert.ok(!log.includes('bad_line'), 'partial line must not be parsed');
});

test('rewritten (shorter) transcript → no duplicates', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const lines = fixtureLines('compact');
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, lines.join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  const before = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events.length;
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(0, 4).join('\n') + '\n'); // shorter
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  fs.appendFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(4).join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  const ev = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events;
  assert.equal(ev.length, before);
  assertContinuous(ev);
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ctx.home, 'logs', 'capture.jsonl'), 'utf8'), /transcript_rewritten/);
});

test('unregistered repo → nothing written, exit 0', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t, { init: false });
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, fixtureLines('basic').join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(ctx.root, '.memory')), false);
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ctx.home, 'logs', 'capture.jsonl'), 'utf8'), /skip_unregistered/);
});

test('secrets on disk are [REDACTED]; thinking and file contents absent', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const extra = JSON.stringify({ type: 'user', uuid: 'u-secret', timestamp: '2026-10-21T10:00:00.000Z', message: { role: 'user', content: 'use ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789 and postgres://admin:[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]@db:5432/x' } });
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, fixtureLines('basic').join('\n') + '\n' + extra + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].file, 'utf8');
  for (const bad of ['ghp_', '[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]', 'sk-ant-', 'SECRET_THINKING', 'FILE_CONTENT_SHOULD_NOT_APPEAR', 'DENIED_ENV_CONTENT']) {
    assert.ok(!raw.includes(bad), `${bad} on disk`);
  }
  assert.match(raw, /postgres:\/\/\[REDACTED\]@db/);
});

test('resume continues same file; SessionEnd marks ended; new session gets new file', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const lines = fixtureLines('basic');
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(0, 6).join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, event: 'SessionStart', extra: { source: 'startup' } });
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, event: 'SessionEnd', extra: { reason: 'prompt_input_exit' } });
  assert.equal(index(ctx.root)[0].status, 'ended');
  fs.appendFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(6).join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, event: 'SessionStart', extra: { source: 'resume' } });
  assert.equal(sessionEvents(ctx.root).length, 1);
  assert.equal(index(ctx.root)[0].status, 'active');
  const sid2 = 'bbbbbbbb-1111-4222-8333-444444444444';
  const t2 = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${sid2}.jsonl`);
  fs.writeFileSync(t2, fixtureLines('compact').join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: sid2, tPath: t2 });
  assert.equal(sessionEvents(ctx.root).length, 2);
  assert.equal(index(ctx.root).length, 2);
});

test('SessionStart before transcript exists → no index entry, later Stop captures', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, event: 'SessionStart', extra: { source: 'startup' } });
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(ctx.root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json')), false);
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, fixtureLines('basic').join('\n') + '\n');
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath });
  assert.equal(sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events.length, 11);
});

test('sweep catches up from stored cursor; hook from a subdirectory works', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const tPath = path.join(ctx.transcripts, `${SID}.jsonl`);
  const lines = fixtureLines('basic');
  fs.writeFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(0, 5).join('\n') + '\n');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(ctx.root, 'sub'));
  hook(ctx, { sid: SID, tPath, cwd: path.join(ctx.root, 'sub') });
  fs.appendFileSync(tPath, lines.slice(5).join('\n') + '\n');
  const r = ctx.memo(['capture', '--sweep', '--verbose']);
  assert.equal(r.status, 0);
  assert.match(r.stdout, /swept 1 session\(s\)/);
  const ev = sessionEvents(ctx.root)[0].events;
  assert.equal(ev.length, 11);
  assertContinuous(ev);
});

test('capture of 1 MB new transcript finishes under 1 s (in-process)', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {

    const l = JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', uuid: `u${i}`, timestamp: '2026-10-21T10:00:00.000Z', message: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: `step ${i} `.repeat(30) }] } });

    size += l.length + 1;

  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = captureSession({ repo, sid: SID, transcriptPath: tPath, event: 'Stop' });
  const ms = Date.now() - t0;
  assert.equal(r.newEvents, out.length);
  assert.ok(ms < 1000, `took ${ms} ms`);
});
