```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo process` — turn captured events into evidence-linked records (P2).
//
// Per repo, per session with events > processedThrough:
//   batch → job id → skip if already applied → prompt → provider → validate
//   → append records → session summary → advance processedThrough (last, atomically).
// Crash-safe: records carry their job id, so a replay of an applied job writes nothing.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const { stateDir } = require('../paths');
const { repoRoot } = require('../git');
const repos = require('../repos');
const config = require('../config');
const { acquire } = require('../lock');
const { log } = require('../log');
const { sha1, readJson, writeJsonAtomic, isoLocal } = require('../util');
const usage = require('../usage');
const sessions = require('../store/sessions');
const records = require('../store/records');
const prompt = require('./prompt');
const { validate } = require('./validate');
const provider = require('../llm/provider');
const sessionSummary = require('../report/session-summary');

const MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 2000;
// Output size used only for the --dry-run cost estimate (plan §10.2: ~1.5k per call).
const OUTPUT_ESTIMATE = 1500;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

function jobsPath(repoId) {
  return path.join(stateDir(repoId), 'jobs.json');
}

function loadJobs(repoId) {
  const value = readJson(jobsPath(repoId), {});
  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {};
}

function saveJobs(repoId, jobs) {
  writeJsonAtomic(jobsPath(repoId), jobs);
}

function jobId(sid, from, to) {
  return 'j-' + sha1(sid + ':' + from + ':' + to).slice(0, 10);
}

// Events of one session file, in seq order.
function readSessionEvents(root, date, sid) {
  const file = sessions.sessionFile(root, date, sid);
  let raw;
  try { raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return [];
    throw err;
  }
  const out = [];
  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    try { out.push(JSON.parse(line)); } catch (_) { /* torn line ignored */ }
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => (a.seq || 0) - (b.seq || 0));
  return out;
}

// Validated items → record op-log lines (§6.2).
function toRecordLines(items, { sid, job, existing }) {
  const lines = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const item of items) {
    const line = { ...item, ts: isoLocal(), job, sessions: [sid], source: 'llm' };
    if (item.op === 'create') {
      const id = records.makeId(item.type, item.statement || item.title, item.evidence[0]);
      // Step 8: an id that already exists becomes an update instead of a duplicate create.
      if (existing.has(id) || seen.has(id)) line.op = 'update';
      line.id = id;
    }
    if (seen.has(line.id) && line.op === 'update') {
      // Two ops on the same id in one batch: keep both, they fold in order.
      lines.push(line);
      continue;
    }
    seen.add(line.id);
    lines.push(line);
  }
  // Stable field order: op, id, type, ts, job first.
  return lines.map((l) => {
    const { op, id, type, ts, job: j, ...rest } = l;
    return { op, id, type, ts, job: j, ...rest };
  });
}

function emptyResult(repo, status) {
  return {
    repo: repo.id,
    root: repo.root,
    status,
    sessions: 0,
    newEvents: 0,
    batches: 0,
    jobs: 0,
    calls: 0,
    in: 0,
    out: 0,
    costEst: 0,
    costKnown: true,
    estimatedInputTokens: 0,
    records: 0,
    summaries: 0,
    leftover: 0,
    dropped: 0,
    errors: []
  };
}

/**
 * Process one registered repo.
 * @param {object} args {repo, cfg, dryRun, retryFailed, maxCalls, providerImpl, verbose}
 */
async function processRepo({ repo, cfg, dryRun = false, retryFailed = false, maxCalls = null, providerImpl = null }) {
  const root = repo.root;
  const result = emptyResult(repo, 'ok');
  const callCap = maxCalls === null ? Number(cfg.maxCallsPerCycle) : maxCalls;

  const index = sessions.loadIndex(root);
  const pendingSessions = index.filter((entry) => {
    if (!entry || !sessions.validSid(entry.sid) || entry.deletedAt) return false;
    return (Number(entry.events) || 0) > (Number(entry.processedThrough) || 0);
  });
  result.sessions = pendingSessions.length;
  for (const entry of pendingSessions) {
    result.newEvents += (Number(entry.events) || 0) - (Number(entry.processedThrough) || 0);
  }
  if (pendingSessions.length === 0) {
    result.status = 'no_new_data';
    return result;
  }

  if (!dryRun) {
    if (cfg.apiEnabled === false || cfg.paused === true) {
      result.status = 'api_disabled';
      return result;
    }
    const budget = usage.budgetState(cfg);
    if (budget.reached) {
      result.status = 'budget_reached';
      result.costEst = budget.costUsd;
      return result;
    }
  }

  const lock = dryRun ? { release() {} } : acquire(path.join(stateDir(repo.id), 'process.lock'), { staleMs: 20 * 60 * 1000 });
  if (!lock) {
    result.status = 'busy';
    return result;
  }

  const llm = dryRun ? null : (providerImpl || provider.create(cfg));
  const jobs = loadJobs(repo.id);
  let stop = null;

  try {
    for (const entry of pendingSessions) {
      if (stop) break;
      const sid = entry.sid;
      const all = readSessionEvents(root, entry.date, sid);
      if (all.length === 0) {
        result.errors.push({ sid, error: 'session file missing or empty' });
        continue;
      }
      let processedThrough = Number(entry.processedThrough) || 0;
      const pending = all.filter((e) => (Number(e.seq) || 0) > processedThrough);
      if (pending.length === 0) continue;

      const openRecords = records.openRecords(root, 60);
      const batches = prompt.batchEvents(pending, {
        maxInputTokens: Number(cfg.maxInputTokensPerCall),
        openRecords,
        repo: path.basename(root)
      });
      result.batches += batches.length;

      for (const batch of batches) {
        const from = processedThrough;
        const to = Number(batch[batch.length - 1].seq) || from;
        const job = jobId(sid, from, to);
        const jobState = jobs[job] || { sid, from, to, status: 'pending', attempts: 0, lastError: null, ts: isoLocal() };

        if (jobState.status === 'failed_permanent' && !retryFailed) {
          result.errors.push({ sid, job, error: 'job failed_permanent (use --retry-failed)' });
          break;
        }
        if (jobState.status === 'failed_retryable' && !retryFailed) {
          result.errors.push({ sid, job, error: 'job failed_retryable (use --retry-failed)' });
          break;
        }

        // Step 4: records already carry this job → it was applied before a crash.
        if (records.hasJob(root, job)) {
          processedThrough = to;
          jobs[job] = { ...jobState, status: 'applied', ts: isoLocal() };
          entry.processedThrough = processedThrough;
          sessions.saveIndex(root, index);
          saveJobs(repo.id, jobs);
          result.jobs++;
          continue;
        }

        const built = prompt.build({
          repo: path.basename(root),
          openRecords: records.openRecords(root, 60),
          events: batch,
          denyPaths: cfg.denyPaths
        });
        result.estimatedInputTokens += built.inputTokens;

        if (dryRun) {
          result.jobs++;
          continue;
        }

        if (callCap !== null && result.calls >= callCap) {
          result.leftover += batch.length;
          result.status = 'max_calls';
          stop = 'max_calls';
          break;
        }
        const budget = usage.budgetState(cfg);
        if (budget.reached) {
          result.status = 'budget_reached';
          result.costEst = budget.costUsd;
          stop = 'budget_reached';
          break;
        }

        const existing = records.byId(root);
        let response;
        let checked;
        try {
          response = await llm.complete({ system: built.system, user: built.user, maxTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS });
          result.calls++;
          const cost = usage.costOf(cfg, response.model, response.usage.input, response.usage.output);
          usage.record({ repoId: repo.id, job, model: response.model, in: response.usage.input, out: response.usage.output, costEst: cost });
          result.in += response.usage.input;
          result.out += response.usage.output;
          if (cost === null) result.costKnown = false;
          else result.costEst += cost;

          checked = validate(response.text, { eventIds: built.eventIds, events: built.events, existing });

          // Step 7: one repair call, then the job is permanently failed.
          if (!checked.ok) {
            const repair = await llm.complete({
              system: built.system,
              user: prompt.repairUser(built.user, checked.error),
              maxTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
            });
            result.calls++;
            const repairCost = usage.costOf(cfg, repair.model, repair.usage.input, repair.usage.output);
            usage.record({ repoId: repo.id, job, model: repair.model, in: repair.usage.input, out: repair.usage.output, costEst: repairCost });
            result.in += repair.usage.input;
            result.out += repair.usage.output;
            if (repairCost === null) result.costKnown = false;
            else result.costEst += repairCost;
            checked = validate(repair.text, { eventIds: built.eventIds, events: built.events, existing });
            response = repair;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          const kind = err && err.kind ? err.kind : 'retryable';
          const attempts = (Number(jobState.attempts) || 0) + 1;
          const status = kind === 'retryable' && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'pending' : 'failed_retryable';
          jobs[job] = { ...jobState, status, attempts, lastError: kind + ': ' + (err && err.message), ts: isoLocal() };
          saveJobs(repo.id, jobs);
          result.errors.push({ sid, job, error: kind + ': ' + (err && err.message) });
          result.status = 'api_failed';
          log('process', { repo: repo.id, sid: sid.slice(0, 8), job, status: 'api_failed', kind, attempts });
          // Nothing was written; events and processedThrough stay untouched for the next run.
          if (kind === 'auth' || kind === 'quota') stop = kind;
          break;
        }

        if (!checked.ok) {
          jobs[job] = {
            ...jobState, status: 'failed_permanent',
            attempts: (Number(jobState.attempts) || 0) + 1,
            lastError: 'invalid JSON after repair: ' + checked.error, ts: isoLocal()
          };
          saveJobs(repo.id, jobs);
          result.errors.push({ sid, job, error: 'invalid JSON after repair' });
          result.status = 'failed_permanent';
          log('process', { repo: repo.id, sid: sid.slice(0, 8), job, status: 'failed_permanent' });
          break;
        }

        const lines = toRecordLines(checked.items, { sid, job, existing });
        if (lines.length > 0) {
          records.ensureDir(root);
          records.append(root, lines);
          result.records += lines.length;
        }
        result.dropped += checked.dropped.length;

        const written = sessionSummary.appendSummary(root, {
          sid,
          date: entry.date,
          agent: entry.agent,
          model: response.model,
          summary: checked.summary,
          from,
          to,
          job,
          recordIds: lines.map((l) => l.id),
          gaps: checked.gaps
        });
        if (written.written) result.summaries++;

        jobs[job] = {
          ...jobState, status: 'applied', attempts: (Number(jobState.attempts) || 0) + 1,
          lastError: null, ts: isoLocal(), items: lines.length
        };
        saveJobs(repo.id, jobs);

        // Step 9: advance processedThrough last, so a crash replays the job instead of losing it.
        processedThrough = to;
        entry.processedThrough = processedThrough;
        if (checked.summary) entry.summary = checked.summary.slice(0, 300);
        sessions.saveIndex(root, index);
        result.jobs++;

        log('process', {
          repo: repo.id, sid: sid.slice(0, 8), job, status: 'ok',
          events: batch.length, items: lines.length, dropped: checked.dropped.length,
          in: response.usage.input, out: response.usage.output
        });
      }
    }
  } finally {
    lock.release();
  }

  if (dryRun) result.status = 'dry_run';
  else if (result.status === 'ok' && result.jobs === 0) result.status = 'no_new_data';
  return result;
}

function fmtUsd(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return 'unknown';
  if (value === 0) return '$0.00';
  return '$' + (value < 0.01 ? value.toFixed(5) : value.toFixed(4));
}

function fmtNum(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString('en-US');
}

function reportLines(result, cfg, dryRun) {
  const name = path.basename(result.root);
  const lines = [name + '  (' + result.status + ')'];
  if (dryRun) {
    const price = config.priceFor(cfg, cfg.model);
    const estOut = result.jobs * OUTPUT_ESTIMATE;
    const cost = price
      ? result.estimatedInputTokens / 1e6 * price.inPerM + estOut / 1e6 * price.outPerM
      : null;
    lines.push('  sessions with new events ' + result.sessions + ' · new events ' + fmtNum(result.newEvents) +
      ' · batches/calls ' + result.jobs);
    lines.push('  estimated input tokens ' + fmtNum(result.estimatedInputTokens) +
      ' · assumed output ' + fmtNum(estOut) + ' (' + OUTPUT_ESTIMATE + '/call)');
    lines.push('  estimated cost ' + (cost === null
      ? 'unknown — no price for ' + cfg.model + ' in config'
      : '≈ ' + fmtUsd(Math.round(cost * 1e6) / 1e6) + ' with ' + cfg.provider + '/' + cfg.model));
    lines.push('  no API call was made (--dry-run)');
  } else {
    lines.push('  sessions ' + result.sessions + ' · new events ' + fmtNum(result.newEvents) +
      ' · jobs ' + result.jobs + ' · calls ' + result.calls);
    lines.push('  records written ' + result.records + ' · items dropped ' + result.dropped +
      ' · summaries ' + result.summaries);
    lines.push('  tokens ' + fmtNum(result.in) + ' in / ' + fmtNum(result.out) + ' out · cost ' +
      (result.costKnown ? '≈ ' + fmtUsd(result.costEst) : '≈ ' + fmtUsd(result.costEst) + ' (some models unpriced)'));
    if (result.leftover > 0) lines.push('  backlog ' + fmtNum(result.leftover) + ' event(s) left for the next run');
  }
  for (const err of result.errors) lines.push('  ! ' + (err.sid ? err.sid.slice(0, 8) + ': ' : '') + err.error);
  return lines;
}

// Repos to work on: --repo <path>, else every enabled registered repo.
function targetRepos(repoArg) {
  if (repoArg) {
    const root = repoRoot(path.resolve(repoArg));
    const repo = repos.find(root);
    if (!repo) throw new Error('repo is not registered — run `memo init` in ' + root);
    if (repo.enabled === false) throw new Error('repo is disabled in ~/.memo/repos.json');
    return [repo];
  }
  return repos.load().filter((r) => r.enabled !== false);
}

async function command(argv = []) {
  const dryRun = argv.includes('--dry-run');
  const retryFailed = argv.includes('--retry-failed');
  const repoFlag = argv.indexOf('--repo');
  const repoArg = repoFlag !== -1 ? argv[repoFlag + 1] : null;
  if (repoFlag !== -1 && !repoArg) throw new Error('usage: memo process --repo <path>');

  const cfg = config.load();
  let list;
  if (repoArg) {
    list = targetRepos(repoArg);
  } else {
    list = targetRepos(null);
    if (list.length === 0) {
      // Fall back to the current repo so `memo process` works right after `memo init`.
      try {
        const repo = repos.find(repoRoot(process.cwd()));
        if (repo) list = [repo];
      } catch (_) { /* not in a git repo */ }
    }
  }
  if (list.length === 0) {
    process.stdout.write('no registered repos — run `memo init` in a repo first\n');
    return { results: [] };
  }

  const out = [];
  let callsLeft = Number(cfg.maxCallsPerCycle);
  for (const repo of list) {
    try {
      const result = await processRepo({ repo, cfg, dryRun, retryFailed, maxCalls: dryRun ? null : callsLeft });
      if (!dryRun) callsLeft = Math.max(0, callsLeft - result.calls);
      out.push(result);
      process.stdout.write(reportLines(result, cfg, dryRun).join('\n') + '\n');
    } catch (err) {
      const result = emptyResult(repo, 'error');
      result.errors.push({ error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err) });
      out.push(result);
      log('process', { repo: repo.id, status: 'error', error: err && err.message });
      process.stdout.write(path.basename(repo.root) + '  (error)\n  ! ' + (err && err.message) + '\n');
    }
  }
  if (!dryRun) {
    const month = usage.monthTotals();
    process.stdout.write('this month: ' + month.calls + ' call(s) · ' + fmtNum(month.input) + ' in / ' +
      fmtNum(month.output) + ' out · ≈ ' + fmtUsd(month.costUsd) + ' of $' + cfg.monthlyBudgetUsd + ' budget\n');
  }
  return { results: out };
}

module.exports = {
  command, processRepo, jobId, jobsPath, loadJobs, saveJobs, readSessionEvents,
  toRecordLines, reportLines, targetRepos, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, OUTPUT_ESTIMATE, MAX_ATTEMPTS
};
```

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

// One live extraction call against a captured-transcript fixture. Opt-in only:
//   MEMO_LIVE=1 node scripts/try-extract.js error-then-fix
// Costs money. Not part of `npm test`, never called by the worker.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const config = require('../src/config');
const { normalize } = require('../src/capture/claude');
const prompt = require('../src/extract/prompt');
const { validate } = require('../src/extract/validate');
const providerFactory = require('../src/llm/provider');
const { MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS } = require('../src/extract/process');
const usage = require('../src/usage');

function fixturePath(name) {
  if (fs.existsSync(name)) return name;
  const file = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'test', 'fixtures', 'claude', name.endsWith('.jsonl') ? name : name + '.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error('fixture not found: ' + name);
  return file;
}

function eventsFrom(file) {
  const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
  const ctx = { sid: 'live-try', root, cwd: root, home: os.homedir(), tools: {}, denyPaths: config.load().denyPaths };
  const out = [];
  let seq = 0;
  let lineNo = 0;
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
    lineNo++;
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    let obj;
    try { obj = JSON.parse(line); } catch (_) { continue; }
    ctx.lineNo = lineNo;
    ctx.raw = line;
    for (const env of normalize(obj, ctx)) out.push({ ...env, seq: ++seq });
  }
  return out;
}

async function main() {
  const name = process.argv[2];
  if (!name) {
    process.stderr.write('usage: MEMO_LIVE=1 node scripts/try-extract.js <fixture>\n');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (process.env.MEMO_LIVE !== '1') {
    process.stderr.write('refusing to call the API: set MEMO_LIVE=1 to allow one live call\n');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const cfg = config.load();
  if (!config.apiKey(cfg)) {
    process.stderr.write('no API key in env ' + config.keyEnvName(cfg) + '\n');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const events = eventsFrom(fixturePath(name));
  const built = prompt.build({ repo: 'memo', openRecords: [], events, denyPaths: cfg.denyPaths });
  console.log('provider ' + cfg.provider + ' · model ' + cfg.model);
  console.log('events ' + events.length + ' · estimated input tokens ' + built.inputTokens);

  const llm = providerFactory.create(cfg);
  const started = Date.now();
  const response = await llm.complete({ system: built.system, user: built.user, maxTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS });
  const cost = usage.costOf(cfg, response.model, response.usage.input, response.usage.output);
  console.log('--- usage ---');
  console.log('model ' + response.model + ' · in ' + response.usage.input + ' · out ' + response.usage.output +
    ' · cost ' + (cost === null ? 'unknown' : '$' + cost.toFixed(6)) + ' · ' + (Date.now() - started) + ' ms');

  const checked = validate(response.text, { eventIds: built.eventIds, events: built.events, existing: new Map() });
  console.log('--- validated ---');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    ok: checked.ok,
    error: checked.error,
    summary: checked.summary,
    items: checked.items,
    dropped: checked.dropped,
    notes: checked.notes,
    gaps: checked.gaps
  }, null, 2));
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error('try-extract failed: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
  process.exit(1);
});
```

````markdown
# Canned model responses

Each file is one reply from the extraction call, replayed by `src/llm/mock.js` so the test
suite needs no API key and no network.

```json
{"response": <object the model would return, or a raw string>,
 "usage": {"input": 4000, "output": 300},
 "model": "claude-haiku-5-5"}
```

The `evidence` ids refer to the synthetic session that `test/process.test.js` writes
(`e-aaaa0001` … `e-aaaa0009`, documented at the top of that file). `model` is a priced
model from `src/config.js` so the cost estimate in `usage.jsonl` is non-null.

Pick a file per call with `MEMO_MOCK_LLM=decision,repair-ok` (comma-separated, one step per
call; the last step repeats). The step names `429`, `500`, `timeout`, `auth`, `quota`,
`bad_request` and `empty` are built into the mock and need no file.
````

````javascript
  { id: 'e-aaaa0003', seq: 3, type: 'tool_result', tool: 'Bash', ok: false, text: '# pass 14\n# fail 1' },
  { id: 'e-aaaa0004', seq: 4, type: 'assistant_text', text: 'The sk- pattern is too short.' },
  { id: 'e-aaaa0008', seq: 8, type: 'tool_result', tool: 'Bash', ok: true, text: '# pass 15\n# fail 0' }
````

```javascript
'use strict';

// Record op-log store (§6.2): ids, folding, open records, job guard.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const records = require('../src/store/records');

function tempRoot(t) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-rec-test-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

function line(extra) {
  return { op: 'create', type: 'decision', ts: '2026-10-22T14:15:00+05:30', job: 'j-1', status: 'active', ...extra };
}

test('ids use the type prefix and are stable for the same statement and evidence', () => {
  const a = records.makeId('decision', 'Keep .memory/ as canonical folder', 'e-3f2a9c1d');
  const b = records.makeId('decision', '  keep   .MEMORY/ as canonical folder  ', 'e-3f2a9c1d');
  assert.equal(a, b, 'statement normalization should ignore case and whitespace');
  assert.match(a, /^D-[0-9a-f]{8}$/);
  assert.notEqual(a, records.makeId('decision', 'Keep .memory/ as canonical folder', 'e-other01'));
  assert.notEqual(a, records.makeId('learning', 'Keep .memory/ as canonical folder', 'e-3f2a9c1d'));
  assert.match(records.makeId('task', 'x', 'e-1'), /^T-/);
  assert.match(records.makeId('intent', 'x', 'e-1'), /^I-/);
  assert.throws(() => records.makeId('nope', 'x', 'e-1'), /unknown record type/);
});

test('file names follow the plan layout', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'decision')), 'decisions.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'error')), 'errors.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'learning')), 'learnings.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'fact')), 'facts.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'task')), 'tasks.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'question')), 'questions.jsonl');
  assert.equal(path.basename(records.filePath(root, 'intent')), 'intent.jsonl');
  assert.ok(records.filePath(root, 'task').includes(path.join('.memory', 'records')));
  assert.throws(() => records.filePath(root, 'nope'), /unknown record type/);
});

test('fold applies ops in file order: last op wins, delete removes', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  records.append(root, [
    line({ id: 'D-1', statement: 'first' }),
    line({ id: 'D-2', statement: 'second' }),
    { op: 'update', id: 'D-1', type: 'decision', ts: 'x', job: 'j-2', status: 'superseded' },
    { op: 'delete', id: 'D-2', type: 'decision', ts: 'x', job: 'j-3' }
  ]);
  const folded = records.fold(root, 'decision');
  assert.equal(folded.size, 1);
  const d1 = folded.get('D-1');
  assert.equal(d1.status, 'superseded');
  assert.equal(d1.statement, 'first', 'update must merge onto the create, not replace it');
  assert.equal(d1.op, undefined, 'folded records carry no op');
  assert.equal(folded.has('D-2'), false);
});

test('missing files fold to nothing and a torn line is skipped', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  assert.equal(records.fold(root, 'task').size, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(records.foldAll(root), []);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  fs.writeFileSync(records.filePath(root, 'task'),
    JSON.stringify(line({ id: 'T-1', type: 'task', status: 'open', statement: 'ok' })) + '\n{"op":"create","id":"T-2"\n');
  const folded = records.fold(root, 'task');
  assert.equal(folded.size, 1);
  assert.equal(folded.get('T-1').statement, 'ok');
});

test('openRecords skips terminal statuses and sorts newest first', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  records.append(root, [
    line({ id: 'D-old', ts: '2026-10-01T10:00:00+05:30', statement: 'old active' }),
    line({ id: 'D-new', ts: '2026-10-20T10:00:00+05:30', statement: 'new active' }),
    line({ id: 'D-rej', ts: '2026-10-21T10:00:00+05:30', statement: 'rejected', status: 'rejected' }),
    { op: 'create', id: 'T-done', type: 'task', ts: '2026-10-21T11:00:00+05:30', job: 'j-1', status: 'done', statement: 'done task' },
    { op: 'create', id: 'T-open', type: 'task', ts: '2026-10-19T11:00:00+05:30', job: 'j-1', status: 'open', statement: 'open task' },
    { op: 'create', id: 'E-ver', type: 'error', ts: '2026-10-21T12:00:00+05:30', job: 'j-1', status: 'verified', statement: 'fixed' },
    { op: 'create', id: 'Q-open', type: 'question', ts: '2026-10-18T12:00:00+05:30', job: 'j-1', status: 'open', statement: 'why?' }
  ]);
  const open = records.openRecords(root);
  assert.deepEqual(open.map((r) => r.id), ['D-new', 'T-open', 'Q-open', 'D-old']);
  assert.equal(records.openRecords(root, 2).length, 2);
  assert.equal(records.byId(root).size, 7, 'byId keeps terminal records too');
  assert.equal(records.isTerminal({ type: 'error', status: 'verified' }), true);
  assert.equal(records.isTerminal({ type: 'error', status: 'reopened' }), false);
});

test('hasJob finds a job id in any record file', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  assert.equal(records.hasJob(root, 'j-abc'), false);
  records.append(root, [{ op: 'create', id: 'F-1', type: 'fact', ts: 'x', job: 'j-abc', status: 'active', statement: 'f' }]);
  assert.equal(records.hasJob(root, 'j-abc'), true);
  assert.equal(records.hasJob(root, 'j-other'), false);
  assert.equal(records.hasJob(root, null), false);
});

test('append refuses lines without a known type or op', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  assert.throws(() => records.append(root, [{ op: 'create', id: 'X-1', type: 'nope' }]), /known type/);
  assert.throws(() => records.append(root, [{ op: 'sing', id: 'F-1', type: 'fact' }]), /op create\|update\|delete/);
});

test('append writes one complete JSON line per record', (t) => {
  const root = tempRoot(t);
  records.ensureDir(root);
  records.append(root, [line({ id: 'D-1', statement: 'a' }), line({ id: 'D-2', statement: 'b' })]);
  records.append(root, [line({ id: 'D-3', statement: 'c' })]);

  const lines = raw.split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  assert.equal(lines.length, 3);
  for (const l of lines) assert.ok(JSON.parse(l).id);
});
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// Provider HTTP behaviour with an injected fetch. No network, no key, no waiting.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const provider = require('../src/llm/provider');
const anthropic = require('../src/llm/anthropic');
const openai = require('../src/llm/openai');
const config = require('../src/config');

const KEY = 'sk-ant-test-0000000000000000000000000000';

function cfg(extra) {
  return { ...config.defaults(), ...extra };
}

// Minimal Response stand-in: only what the providers read.
function reply(status, body, headers = {}) {
  const map = new Map(Object.entries(headers).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), String(v)]));
  return {
    status,
    headers: { get: (name) => (map.has(String(name).toLowerCase()) ? map.get(String(name).toLowerCase()) : null) },
    text: async () => (typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body))
  };
}

function fakeFetch(replies) {
  const calls = [];
  const queue = [...replies];
  const fn = async (url, init) => {
    calls.push({ url, init, body: JSON.parse(init.body) });
    const next = queue.length > 1 ? queue.shift() : queue[0];
    if (typeof next === 'function') return next();
    return next;
  };
  fn.calls = calls;
  return fn;
}

function opts(fetchImpl, extra = {}) {
  const slept = [];
  return {
    impl: { fetchImpl, apiKey: KEY, sleep: (ms) => slept.push(ms), backoff: [1, 2, 3], ...extra },
    slept
  };
}

const ANTHROPIC_OK = {
  id: 'msg_01abc',
  model: 'claude-haiku-5-5',
  stop_reason: 'end_turn',
  // Current models think by default and return an empty thinking block first.
  content: [{ type: 'thinking', thinking: '' }, { type: 'text', text: '{"schema":1,' }, { type: 'text', text: '"items":[]}' }],
  usage: { input_tokens: 4321, output_tokens: 123 }
};

test('anthropic: request shape, headers and response parsing', async () => {
  const fetchImpl = fakeFetch([reply(200, ANTHROPIC_OK, { 'request-id': 'req_1' })]);
  const { impl } = opts(fetchImpl);
  const p = anthropic.create(cfg(), impl);
  const out = await p.complete({ system: 'SYS', user: 'USER', maxTokens: 2000 });

  assert.equal(fetchImpl.calls.length, 1);
  const call = fetchImpl.calls[0];
  assert.equal(call.url, 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages');
  assert.equal(call.init.method, 'POST');
  assert.equal(call.init.headers['x-api-key'], KEY);
  assert.equal(call.init.headers['anthropic-version'], '2023-06-01');
  assert.equal(call.init.headers['content-type'], 'application/json');
  assert.equal(call.body.model, 'claude-haiku-5-5');
  assert.equal(call.body.max_tokens, 2000);
  assert.equal(call.body.system, 'SYS');
  assert.deepEqual(call.body.messages, [{ role: 'user', content: 'USER' }]);

  // All text blocks joined, thinking block ignored.
  assert.equal(out.text, '{"schema":1,"items":[]}');
  assert.deepEqual(out.usage, { input: 4321, output: 123 });
  assert.equal(out.model, 'claude-haiku-5-5');
  assert.equal(out.requestId, 'msg_01abc');
});

test('anthropic: 429 is retried honouring retry-after, then succeeds', async () => {
  const fetchImpl = fakeFetch([
    reply(429, { error: { message: 'rate limited' } }, { 'retry-after': '1' }),
    reply(200, ANTHROPIC_OK)
  ]);
  const { impl, slept } = opts(fetchImpl);
  const out = await anthropic.create(cfg(), impl).complete({ system: 's', user: 'u' });
  assert.equal(fetchImpl.calls.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(slept, [1000], 'retry-after seconds win over the backoff table');
  assert.equal(out.usage.input, 4321);
});

test('anthropic: 401 is auth and is not retried', async () => {
  const fetchImpl = fakeFetch([reply(401, { error: { message: 'invalid x-api-key' } })]);
  const { impl, slept } = opts(fetchImpl);
  await assert.rejects(
    () => anthropic.create(cfg(), impl).complete({ system: 's', user: 'u' }),
    (err) => {
      assert.equal(err.name, 'ProviderError');
      assert.equal(err.kind, 'auth');
      assert.equal(err.status, 401);
      return true;
    }
  );
  assert.equal(fetchImpl.calls.length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(slept, []);
});

test('anthropic: 500 is retried three times then throws retryable', async () => {
  const fetchImpl = fakeFetch([reply(500, 'upstream boom')]);
  const { impl, slept } = opts(fetchImpl);
  await assert.rejects(
    () => anthropic.create(cfg(), impl).complete({ system: 's', user: 'u' }),

test('anthropic: 400 is bad_request, credit-balance 400 is quota', async () => {

  );

test('an aborted request is retryable and reports a timeout', async () => {

});
```

```javascript
// `memo process` end to end with the mock provider: no key, no network.
//
// The synthetic session below is the contract the canned responses in
// test/fixtures/llm/ refer to:
//   e-aaaa0001 seq 1 user_prompt      "npm test is failing, fix it"
//   e-aaaa0002 seq 2 tool_call  Bash  "npm test"
//   e-aaaa0003 seq 3 tool_result Bash ok:false  (failing suite)
//   e-aaaa0004 seq 4 assistant_text   diagnosis
//   e-aaaa0005 seq 5 tool_call  Edit  src/redact.js
//   e-aaaa0006 seq 6 tool_result Edit ok:true
//   e-aaaa0007 seq 7 tool_call  Bash  "npm test"
//   e-aaaa0008 seq 8 tool_result Bash ok:true   (passing suite)
//   e-aaaa0009 seq 9 assistant_text   "All 15 tests pass now."

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');
const FIX = path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures', 'claude');
const HAS_GIT = !spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error;
const SKIP = !HAS_GIT && 'git not installed';

const SID = 'cccccccc-1111-4222-8333-444444444444';
const SID2 = 'dddddddd-1111-4222-8333-444444444444';
const DATE = '2026-10-21';

function events(sid = SID) {
  const at = (n) => '2026-10-21T09:0' + n + ':00.000+05:30';
  const base = (seq, id, type, extra) => ({ v: 1, id, sid, seq, ts: at(seq), agent: 'claude-code', type, ...extra });
  return [
    base(1, 'e-aaaa0001', 'user_prompt', { text: 'npm test is failing, fix it' }),
    base(2, 'e-aaaa0002', 'tool_call', { tool: 'Bash', text: 'npm test' }),
    base(3, 'e-aaaa0003', 'tool_result', { tool: 'Bash', ok: false, text: '# pass 14\n# fail 1' }),
    base(4, 'e-aaaa0004', 'assistant_text', { text: 'The redact test fails because the sk- pattern is too short. Fixing src/redact.js.' }),
    base(5, 'e-aaaa0005', 'tool_call', { tool: 'Edit', text: 'src/redact.js (-1 +1 lines)' }),
    base(6, 'e-aaaa0006', 'tool_result', { tool: 'Edit', ok: true, text: 'ok' }),
    base(7, 'e-aaaa0007', 'tool_call', { tool: 'Bash', text: 'npm test' }),
    base(8, 'e-aaaa0008', 'tool_result', { tool: 'Bash', ok: true, text: '# tests 15\n# pass 15\n# fail 0' }),
    base(9, 'e-aaaa0009', 'assistant_text', { text: 'All 15 tests pass now.' })
  ];
}

function setup(t, { config: configPatch = {}, sessions: extraSessions = [] } = {}) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-proc-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, 'repo');
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const env = { ...process.env, MEMO_HOME: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1' };
  delete env.MEMO_MOCK_LLM;
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, env });

  const memo = (args, extraEnv) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env: { ...env, ...extraEnv }
  });
  assert.equal(memo(['init']).status, 0);

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'config.json'), JSON.stringify({
    v: 1, provider: 'mock', model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', ...configPatch
  }, null, 2) + '\n');

  const index = [];
  const all = [{ sid: SID, list: events(SID) }, ...extraSessions];
  for (const { sid, list } of all) {
    const dir = path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', '2026', '10', '21');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, sid + '.jsonl'), list.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n') + '\n');
    index.push({
      sid, agent: 'claude-code', date: DATE, start: list[0].ts, end: list[list.length - 1].ts,
      events: list.length, processedThrough: 0, summary: '', status: 'ended'
    });
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), JSON.stringify(index, null, 2) + '\n');

  return { base, root, home, memo, env };
}

function recordLines(root, file) {
  const p = path.join(root, '.memory', 'records', file);
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
}

function allRecords(root) {
  const dir = path.join(root, '.memory', 'records');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  return fs.readdirSync(dir).flatMap((f) => recordLines(root, f));
}

function usageLines(home) {
  const p = path.join(home, 'logs', 'usage.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
}

function index(root) {
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), 'utf8'));
}

function jobs(home, root) {
  const repos = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(home, 'repos.json'), 'utf8'));
  const file = path.join(home, 'state', repos[0].id, 'jobs.json');
  return fs.existsSync(file) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')) : {};
}

function summaryFile(root, sid = SID) {
  return path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', '2026', '10', '21', sid + '.md');
}

  const r = ctx.memo(['process'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'decision' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.match(r.stdout, /max_calls/);
  assert.match(r.stdout, /backlog 9 event\(s\)/);
  assert.equal(usageLines(ctx.home).length, 1);
  const idx = index(ctx.root);
  assert.equal(idx.find((e) => e.sid === SID).processedThrough, 9);
  assert.equal(idx.find((e) => e.sid === SID2).processedThrough, 0);
});

test('a small token cap splits one session into several jobs', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t, { config: { maxInputTokensPerCall: 1000 } });

  const ids = new Set(allRecords(ctx.root).map((l) => l.job));
  assert.ok(ids.size >= 2, 'each batch gets its own job id');
  assert.equal(index(ctx.root)[0].processedThrough, 9);
  const md = fs.readFileSync(summaryFile(ctx.root), 'utf8');

});
```

````markdown
# Phase 2 — API extraction

What `memo process` does: takes the events Phase 1 captured, sends only the **new** ones to
the configured model, validates the reply in code, and writes evidence-linked records plus a
session summary. Phase 1 behaviour is unchanged.

**Status: not executed.** The code below was written without running the test suite and
without any API call, on request. Nothing here is a claim that it works at runtime.

## New modules

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/config.js` | `~/.memo/config.json` load / sanitize / `set`; price table; API-key lookup (never prints the key) |
| `src/usage.js` | `chars/4` token estimate, cost per call, `~/.memo/logs/usage.jsonl`, monthly budget state |
| `src/store/records.js` | `.memory/records/*.jsonl` append-only op-log: ids, fold (last op wins), open records, job guard |
| `src/llm/provider.js` | interface, factory, `ProviderError{kind}`, 3 attempts with 2 s / 8 s / 30 s backoff, `retry-after`, 60 s abort |
| `src/llm/anthropic.js` | `POST /v1/messages` (`x-api-key`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`) |
| `src/llm/openai.js` | `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `response_format: json_object` |
| `src/llm/mock.js` | replays `test/fixtures/llm/*.json`; simulates 429 / 500 / timeout / auth / quota / malformed |
| `src/extract/prompt.js` | fixed system rules, user payload, token-capped batching, **second redaction stage** |
| `src/extract/validate.js` | the §6.3 rules in code: enums, caps, evidence checks, downgrades |
| `src/extract/process.js` | jobs, idempotency, retries, budget, call cap, cursor advance |
| `src/report/session-summary.js` | `.memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.md` |
| `scripts/try-extract.js` | one opt-in live call (`MEMO_LIVE=1`), not part of `npm test` |

## Commands

```
memo config                        print settings (key shown only as "set (…last4)")
memo config set <key> <value>      e.g. provider, model, monthlyBudgetUsd, apiEnabled,
                                   maxInputTokensPerCall, prices.<model>.inPerM
memo process                       process new events in every registered repo
memo process --dry-run             event count + estimated input tokens + estimated cost, no API call
memo process --repo <path>         one repo only
memo process --retry-failed        retry jobs parked as failed_permanent / failed_retryable
```

## What stops a surprise bill

- No new events → no call at all (`no_new_data`).
- `--dry-run` never constructs a provider and never calls one.
- `monthlyBudgetUsd` (default $5) is checked before every call, from real provider token counts.
- `maxInputTokensPerCall` (default 12,000) caps one request; `maxCallsPerCycle` (default 6) caps a run, and the leftover backlog is reported.
- `memo config set apiEnabled false` (or `paused true`) stops processing while capture keeps running.

## Privacy

Redaction runs twice: once at capture (Phase 1, on disk) and again in `extract/prompt.js`
before anything leaves the machine. Events are sent with `id, seq, ts, type, tool, text, ok,
truncated` only — no transcript line numbers, no uuids, no absolute paths. Any event whose
text names a denylisted path (`.env`, `*.pem`, `secrets/**`, …) is dropped from the request.
The key is read from the env var named by `apiKeyEnv` (fallback `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` /
`OPENAI_API_KEY`), is never written to a log, and provider logs carry only status, kind,
attempt and request id.

## How the model is kept honest

The model proposes; `extract/validate.js` decides. It drops unknown fields, enforces every
enum, caps strings at 500 chars and items at 25, drops any item whose evidence id is not in
the batch or an existing record, drops updates to ids that do not exist or whose type does not
match, requires `user_prompt` evidence for `intent`, and **downgrades** `verified` / `done` to
`resolved_unverified` / `implemented_unverified` with `downgraded: true` unless an evidence
event is a `tool_result` with `ok: true`. `auto_exec` is always written as `false`.

## Idempotency

Job id = `j-` + 10 hex of `sha1(sid:from:to)`, and every record line carries its `job`. If a
run crashes after records were appended but before `processedThrough` advanced, the next run
sees the job in the record files, advances the cursor and makes no call. `processedThrough` in
`.memory/sessions/index.json` is always written last.

## How to test this by hand (nothing below has been run)

```bash
npm test                       # the offline suite: no key, no network
memo process --dry-run         # event count, token estimate, cost estimate, zero calls
```

Offline, with the mock provider (no key needed):

```bash
memo config set provider mock
MEMO_MOCK_LLM=decision memo process
cat .memory/records/decisions.jsonl
cat .memory/sessions/2026/10/21/<sid>.md
memo process                   # expect "no_new_data" and no new usage line
```

Then the real thing, once `docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md` §7 names a model:

```bash
memo config set provider anthropic
memo config set model claude-haiku-5-5     # confirm this is the model you picked
setx MEMO_API_KEY "<key>"                  # new terminal afterwards
memo process --dry-run                     # check the estimate first
memo process
```

Worth checking by eye on the first real run:

1. every `evidence` id in `.memory/records/*.jsonl` exists in that session's `.jsonl`;
2. nothing is marked `verified` / `done` that no passing tool result supports;
3. the session `.md` summary matches what actually happened;
4. a second `memo process` adds no records and no line to `~/.memo/logs/usage.jsonl`;
5. with the network off: an error is logged, nothing is deleted, and the next run picks up where it stopped.

One live call against a fixture, costing one request:

```bash
MEMO_LIVE=1 node scripts/try-extract.js error-then-fix
```

## Open points

- **Model id is a default, not a decision.** `docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md` §7 is still a template,
  so `src/config.js` defaults to `claude-haiku-5-5` (cheapest tier per plan §3 #6, $0.10/$0.50
  per 1M). Change it with `memo config set model <id>` once the spike is done.
- **Provider request shapes are unverified against live docs.** No network call was allowed for
  this work, so both providers follow the shapes written in the plan and the bundled API
  reference. The first real call is the test. For OpenAI, `max_completion_tokens` is sent and the
  Responses-API question in the plan is still open.
- **Structured-output / JSON mode is deliberately not used for Anthropic**: the plan permits it
  only if P0 verified it in current docs. Plain text plus the validator is used instead.
- Reports (`PROJECT_STATE.md`, `TASKS.md`), `memo commit`, the 15-minute worker and
  `memo clear` are Phase 3–5 and are not part of this change.
````
